title: Part-Time Social Media Manager | Long-Term Role
description:
Part-Time Social Media Manager | Long-Term Role

$7/hour | Around 25 hours/week



We’re hoping to find someone who will still be part of our team years from now.



Someone who wants to get to know our company, take ownership of our social media, and become a colleague we can genuinely count on. If you’re looking for a steady working relationship where you can grow over time, we’d love to hear from you.



We’re Kids On Stage, an award-winning Los Angeles performing arts company offering theater classes, musical theater programs, camps, and enrichment experiences for children and teens since 1987.



We’re a small, close-knit team, and we’ve rarely let employees go. We value people who want to stay, contribute, and build trust, not just finish a few projects and move on. This role starts part-time, with the potential for the right person to grow into a full-time position within a year.



What we need your help with:



We have performances, rehearsals, and plenty of moments worth sharing. We need someone who can see the possibilities in that material and turn it into thoughtful, engaging content that connects with parents and supports enrollment.



You’ll own the process from beginning to end: d
 what to create and why, making it, publishing it, and checking whether it worked. This isn’t a strategy-only position or a role where you’ll simply wait for editing and design assignments.



Our goal is ambitious: make KOS the social media leader among our competitors within six months, then maintain that position. You’ll be responsible for planning how we get there and improving results along the way, while respecting our brand and understanding what KOS parents respond to and what they don’t.



Your work will include:



- Setting social media goals and d
 where to focus our efforts

- Automating reporting and tracking performance for KOS and our competitors

- Developing monthly content plans and original ideas

- Editing Reels and YouTube Shorts from supplied footage

- Writing hooks, captions, scripts, and calls to action

- Creating graphics, carousels, covers, testimonials, and enrollment posts

- Publishing and repurposing content across Instagram,
, and YouTube

- Reviewing results and making practical improvements



What it’s like to work with us:



We care about the details, and we have high standards. You’ll work closely with several colleagues and directly with our CEO for design and Reel approvals.



We want you to bring ideas and explain your thinking. If you disagree with a direction, even the CEO’s, we want you to feel comfortable saying so respectfully and making your case. We don’t expect you to agree with everything. We do expect you to listen, handle feedback professionally, and follow through once a decision is made.



We expect around 20-25 hours of work per week, although some weeks may require more. For significant projects, you’ll propose a time budget, and we’ll discuss and approve it together.



You’ll need:



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Exceptional attention to detail, including checking your own work before submitting it

- Strong short-form video-editing skills using Canva, CapCut, or other editing tools

- Solid graphic-design skills in Canva and/or Adobe

- Experience planning content, not just producing whatever someone assigns

- The ability to follow detailed brand standards while bringing fresh ideas

- A practical, enthusiastic approach to AI and automation: use them wherever they can improve efficiency, while applying your own judgment and checking the output

- The confidence to explain and advocate for your choices, with the company’s best interests in mind

- A professional approach to feedback and revisions

- Excellent organization and file management

- A reliable computer, internet connection, backup internet, and remote-work setup



We’re looking for someone who takes the work seriously and wants a place to stay and grow. In return, we want to give the right person room to become a trusted, long-term part of KOS.



To apply:



Read the full listing.

Do NOT use AI in your application :)



First, complete the required xInterview video interview. This step is mandatory:







Once completed, you will be directed to a Google Form to finalize your application.

- Every video is one CapCut build exported three ways: a clean trim, a TikTok version (+ sound effects + green screen overlays + screen recordings, no captions), and an Instagram version (+ animated captions in our brand font)

- Add strategic cuts, zooms, B-roll, and simple visual emphasis

- Match my existing editing style using a gold-standard reference video and organized asset library

- Organize project files correctly in our shared Google Drive / CapCut Teamspace

- Communicate clearly, deliver before deadlines, and make revisions quickly and accurately



Requirements:

- Expert in CapCut (non-negotiable)

- Strong short-form editing portfolio with talking-head content

- Clean, subtle sound design (soft whooshes, pops, typing sounds — not trending-audio chaos)

- Excellent attention to detail

- Reliable internet and editing setup

- Clear written English

- Ability to complete a paid test edit within 48 hours

- Comfortable signing an NDA — my business involves student privacy and I take it seriously



How this role works:

Starting part-time: 4 hours/day, 5 days/week, at $5–6/hour (roughly $433–520/month) while we establish footage volume and consistency. After a successful 2-week paid trial, we'll reassess — hours can grow to 6/day, and rate is revisited after 30 days based on completed videos, revision rate, and deadline adherence.



To apply, send:

1. Three short-form examples you personally edited (talking-head content preferred)

2. Your editing software and computer specs

3. Your available hours and time zone

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. A 60-second introduction video

6. Confirmation you can complete a paid test edit within 48 hours



I'll shortlist quickly and run a single 30–60 second paid test edit with finalists — scored on hook retention, captions, pacing, clean cuts, following instructions, and communication.

title: Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager
description:
I am looking for a creative, reliable, and highly organized Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager for an ongoing part-time role.



I have an established library of podcast interviews and other content that I want to refresh, tighten, repackage, and repurpose for YouTube and podcast platforms.



Some older episodes are still highly relevant but may need stronger editing for today’s audience. For example, a 20-minute interview may be much stronger at 10–12 minutes if the unnecessary sections are removed and the main story is brought forward. Some are audio only; some are video and audio.



This role requires more than technical editing. I am looking for someone with strong editorial judgment and excellent copywriting skills.



Responsibilities



You may be responsible for:



Editing podcast audio and video

Tightening older episodes while preserving the speaker’s meaning and natural voice

Removing repetition, long pauses and sections that do not add value

Creating polished intros and outros

Preparing episodes for YouTube and podcast platforms

Writing strong episode titles

Writing descriptions, summaries and show notes

Writing promotional copy

Identifying strong hooks and key moments

Creating or coordinating thumbnails

Creating YouTube Shorts and social media clips

Adding captions and subtitles

Organizing content into playlists and categories

Optimizing content for search and discoverability

Reviewing older content and recommending how it can be repurposed

Helping create a consistent visual and editorial style

Reviewing analytics and identifying which topics, titles and formats perform best

Suggesting ways to improve reach, engagement and audience growth

Copywriting Is a Major Part of This Role



Strong written English is essential.



I do not want generic descriptions or titles that sound AI-generated.



You should be able to listen to an interview, understand what makes it interesting, and turn that into compelling copy that makes someone want to click, watch or listen.



For example:



Weak:

“Interview with Jane Smith about her life journey”



Stronger:

“Starting Over After Everything Changed: A Story of Resilience and Purpose”



You need to be able to find the real story inside the conversation.



You May Be a Good Fit If You:

Have excellent written and spoken English

Have experience editing podcasts and/or YouTube videos

Understand audience retention

Understand YouTube titles, thumbnails and basic SEO

Are a strong copywriter

Have good storytelling instincts

Can identify the strongest parts of a conversation

Can work independently once you understand the style and expectations

Are comfortable making recommendations

Are highly organized

Pay close attention to detail

Prefer clean, professional editing over excessive effects



Experience with interview-based podcasts, educational content, wellness, leadership, coaching or personal development is helpful but not required.



This Is Not the Right Role If:

You only provide basic technical editing

You rely entirely on AI for titles and descriptions

You need detailed instructions for every task

You are uncomfortable making editorial decisions

Your editing style focuses more on effects than improving the content itself

Ongoing Work



This is an ongoing part-time role.



There is a substantial library of existing content to work through, along with new content being created.



I am looking for someone who could potentially become a long-term member of my content team.



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and your relevant experience.

Links to 2–3 podcasts or YouTube videos you have edited or produced.

Examples of titles, descriptions, show notes or promotional copy you personally wrote.

Tell me what makes a podcast episode interesting enough for someone to keep listening.

Tell me what you would look for when d
 how to turn a 20-minute interview into a stronger 10–15 minute episode.

Begin your application with the word "Motivation" so I know you read the full posting.



Please do not send a generic application.



I am much more interested in finding someone with strong judgment, communication skills and creative ability than receiving a long list of software programs you know how to use.

title: Short-Term Rental Guest Communication VA – Airbnb, Vrbo & Hospitable
description:
We are a U.S.-based short-term rental/property management company looking for an experienced STR Virtual Assistant to join our team long-term.



Your primary role will be handling guest communication and support through Airbnb, Vrbo, and Hospitable.



This is not an entry-level VA position. Previous hands-on STR experience AND Hospitable experience are required.



Responsibilities



* Monitor and respond to guest messages through Hospitable, Airbnb & Vrbo

* Provide fast, friendly and professional guest support

* Troubleshoot check-in, door-code, Wi-Fi and other property issues

* Handle guest complaints calmly and professionally

* Coordinate with cleaners and maintenance providers when needed

* Follow up with guests to make sure issues are resolved

* Recognize when an issue needs to be immediately escalated

* Follow our SOPs while also using good judgment to solve problems independently



Many routine messages are already automated, so we need someone who can problem-solve—not simply copy and paste responses.



Availability



Our rentals operate 24/7, so guest messages and urgent issues can occur outside normal U.S. business hours.



We need someone who is highly responsive and able to provide reliable extended coverage, including nights, weekends and holidays.



Some days may be very quiet while others may have multiple guest issues.



Please be honest about the hours you can realistically cover and how you handle urgent overnight messages.



Internet & Reliability — REQUIRED



You MUST have a strong, reliable high-speed internet connection.



Please do not apply if you live in a rural area with frequently slow, spotty or unreliable internet/mobile service.



You must also have a backup internet option, such as reliable mobile data/hotspot or a secondary connection.



Because our guests depend on timely responses, recurring internet/connectivity problems will not work for this position.



What We’re Looking For



* Previous Airbnb & Vrbo experience

* Previous Hospitable experience

* Excellent written English

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Calm and professional with difficult guests

* Reliable and highly responsive

* Comfortable communicating with cleaners and maintenance

* Able to work independently and know when to escalate an issue

* Interested in a long-term position



Compensation



This position will be paid at an agreed-upon set daily rate rather than hourly because message volume varies from day to day.



Please include your requested daily rate in USD when applying.



There is potential for additional responsibilities and growth within our company for the right person.



How to Apply



Start your application with the words:



HOSPITABLE VA



Then answer these questions:



1. Describe your STR experience, including how long you’ve worked in the industry and the largest number of properties you’ve supported at one time.

2. Which platforms have you personally worked with? Please specifically describe your experience using Hospitable.

3. What hours are you realistically available in Philippine Time (PHT), and how do you handle urgent overnight guest messages?

4. What type of internet connection do you have? Do you have backup internet/mobile data, and how often do you experience internet or power outages?

5. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, approximately how many hours per week?

6. What is your requested daily rate in USD?

7. Briefly describe a difficult STR guest situation you personally handled and how you resolved it.



Guest Scenario



A guest arrives at 11:30 PM and messages:



“Our door code isn’t working. We’ve been traveling all day and we’re exhausted. If you can’t get us inside immediately, I want a full refund.”



Please provide:



1. The exact message you would send the guest.

2. The steps you would take immediately afterward.



We’re looking for someone dependable who understands hospitality, communicates well, and can become a trusted long-term member of our team.



If you have strong STR experience, Hospitable experience, reliable internet and excellent guest communication skills, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Pinterest & Content VA
description:
Pinterest & Content VA — Job Description

Position: Pinterest Marketing Virtual Assistant 

About the Role

I’m looking for a creative Pinterest VA specialist who has experience working with small, niche markets where the emphasis is on clicks, not reach. Must be on top of changing Pinterest environment. Experience building a brand new Pinterest account is a plus. I have a writing curriculum for struggling writers in grades 3-8 that has been used for 30 years but never marketed directly. Its specific audience is homeschooling parents of reluctant writers in upper elementary and middle school. 



This is a great fit for someone who understands Pinterest as a search and discovery engine (not a social feed) and knows how to design pins that stop the scroll for a specific audience — in this case, homeschooling parents.



Responsibilities to include:

--Set up the six initial boards and their descriptions (already created).  

--Create fresh pin variations for an initial posting of 6 pins the first week posted to 2-3 boards that establish a strong niche signal.The volume will increase slowly, growing to 25+ pins/wk over the following months.

--UTM tagging on all pins using Google URL Builder/google spreadsheet

--Design custom pins as well as template and graphics designed in Canva using my existing brand (colors, fonts, photos). 

--Create multiple fresh pin variations all pointing to ONE URL landing page over the next 60-90 days.

--Use SEO-optimized pin titles and descriptions using homeschool-writing-niche keywords. 

--Schedule and publish pins on a consistent cadence and according to Pinterest best practices for new accounts and posting to one URL, using Pinterest native scheduler

--Monitor Pinterest Analytics and report on key metrics (impressions, saves, outbound clicks, top-performing pins) on a regular basis

--Recommend adjustments to pin design or strategy based on performance data



Requirements

Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience running Pinterest for a business or brand (please share Pinterest analytics screenshots or a portfolio of pins you've created)

Minimum 2 years experience with UTM/URL tagging

Minimum 5 years of experience with Canva, including working from brand kits/templates

Demonstrated understanding of Pinterest SEO (keyword research, pin titles/descriptions, board strategy)

Experience with Pinterest for content-based or educational brands preferred (parenting, education, homeschooling, or curriculum niches a strong plus)

Comfortable working from provided brand guidelines, existing website copy, and photos rather than generating brand identity from scratch

Strong written English for pin copy

Reliable communication and ability to meet weekly/monthly deliverable cadences



The following would be nice to have, but NOT necessary:

Experience with ConvertKit (now Kit)

Experience with WordPress sites (for occasional light coordination with my web developer) — not required



What I'll Provide

Brand assets: logo, brand colors/fonts, photos

Existing landing page and lead magnet content

Target audience profile and messaging guidelines

Priority keywords already identified for this niche



Scope & Structure

Starting scope: Finish Pinterest account setup + initial batch of pins 

Ongoing: pin creation and account management

Please share your typical turnaround time, and 2–3 examples of Pinterest accounts you've grown



How to Apply

To be considered, please start your message with the word PINBOARD so I know you read this full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Cross-Channel AI Content & Marketing Specialist
description:
We are an internationally operating digital marketing agency working with clients across different countries and industries.

We are looking for a reliable and proactive Cross-Channel AI Content & Marketing Specialist to join our team on a long-term, full-time basis.



This role combines social media, content creation, video editing, SEO, analytics and AI automation. We are looking for someone who can create strong content, understand performance, and continuously look for ways to improve and automate marketing workflows using the latest AI tools.



AI is a core part of how we work. You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and interested in building AI-powered systems, automations and agentic workflows rather than using AI only for basic content generation.

This is not a short-term freelance project. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team and grow with the agency.



Your responsibilities

• Create and manage content across Instagram, LinkedIn,
, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant channels.

• Edit high-quality short-form and long-form video with strong hooks, pacing and storytelling.

• Create social media graphics, carousels, thumbnails and other marketing assets.

• Support content planning, research, scheduling and publishing.

• Write and improve captions, hooks, headlines and marketing copy.

• Research trends, competitors, keywords and content opportunities.

• Support SEO, keyword research, metadata, internal linking and on-page optimization.

• Work with Local SEO and continuously learn and apply developments in AEO, AI Search and emerging search behaviour.

• Monitor performance using tools such as GA4, Google Search Console and platform analytics.

• Use AI tools to improve content creation, research, analysis and marketing processes.

• Build AI automations, agentic workflows and repeatable systems using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs and webhooks.

• Understand how Claude, ChatGPT and other LLMs can connect with tools, data and external platforms through APIs, MCP, skills or comparable technologies.

• Stay informed about new AI tools and proactively suggest ways to improve efficiency, quality and scalability.

• Support Google Ads, Meta Ads or other performance marketing activities where relevant.



Essential skills and experience

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, content creation or social media.

• Strong video editing skills are essential.

• Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar tools.

• Strong understanding of social media content and platform-specific formats.

• Good graphic design skills using Canva, Adobe tools or comparable software.

• Strong written English and the ability to create engaging marketing content.

• Good understanding of SEO, content optimization and analytics.

• Hands-on experience using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or comparable AI tools.

• Practical experience with AI automation is essential.

• Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms.

• Understanding of APIs, webhooks and how different tools can be connected.

• Familiarity with AI agents, agentic workflows and modern LLM integrations.

• Strong curiosity about new AI tools, models and marketing technologies.

• Ability to think independently and improve processes rather than simply follow instructions.



Highly desirable experience

• Local SEO and Google Business Profile.

• AEO and AI Search optimization.

• Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog or similar SEO tools.

• GA4 and Google Search Console.

• WordPress or Shopify.

• YouTube SEO and thumbnail optimization.

• Google Ads and Meta Ads.

• Looker Studio or automated reporting.

• AI video generation and AI-assisted creative workflows.

• MCP, custom AI tools, skills or multi-step AI workflows.

• Basic knowledge of JSON, APIs or scripting.



Communication and working style

Strong spoken and written English is essential.



You should be someone who:

• Communicates clearly and professionally.

• Takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

• Thinks about the wider objective behind a task.

• Identifies opportunities for improvement and automation.

• Raises questions or potential problems early.

• Provides transparent progress updates.

• Works independently while staying closely connected to the team.

• Is reliable, organised and able to manage several projects at the same time.

• Is open to feedback and interested in continuously learning.

We especially value people who regularly ask:

Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently with AI?

Commitment



This is a full-time, long-term position.

Our team operates mainly during European working hours, so reliable overlap with CET/CEST is required.

The starting compensation is approximately USD 500 per month, depending on experience, skills and overall fit.

There is room for responsibilities and compensation to grow over time for someone who proves reliable and becomes an important part of the team.



Write “AI FIRST” at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.



How to apply

Please include:

• A short introduction.

• Your location, time zone and availability.

• Your portfolio or examples of relevant work.

• Examples of social media content you have created or managed.

• At least two or three examples of videos you personally edited.

• Examples of graphics, carousels or thumbnails.

• A short explanation of your SEO and analytics experience.

• At least one example of an AI automation, agentic workflow or system you have built.

• Which AI models, automation platforms and marketing tools you use regularly.

• An example of a new AI tool or workflow you have recently learned or tested.

• A short explanation of your personal contribution to the work you provide.



We are especially interested in understanding how you think, how you use AI, how you improve performance and how reliably you execute, not only which tools you have used.

description:
Summary

We’re looking for an
 Designer to join our retention marketing team and become the dedicated
 designer for our men’s belt brand.

 marketing.

 is a big plus, but if you’re a strong designer, the specifics of

The Role



You’ll be the dedicated
 designer for one of our brands. Our other brand already has its own designer, so you’ll be able to really dive into this brand, understand its customers and visual identity, and become very familiar with what works for it.



You’ll work directly with our Head of Retention, who leads the
 strategy and direction, as well as the other designers on the team.

You’ll be involved in:



- Coming up with ideas and concepts for campaigns

- Designing campaigns and flows in Figma

- Writing and improving
 copy together with AI

- Building and setting up
s inside Klaviyo

- Finding the right imagery and content for your designs

- Thinking about layout, hierarchy, storytelling, and how to communicate an offer or message visually

- Bringing your own ideas to campaigns and discussions

- Asking for feedback and improving your work

- Participating in concepting, feedback, and strategy calls with the team



You’ll have freedom to be creative and bring your own input, while working within the strategy and direction set by the Head of Retention.



If you’re looking for a role where every concept, wireframe, asset, and piece of copy is completely prepared for you before you start designing, this probably isn’t the right fit.



We want a designer who enjoys being involved in the process.



What We’re Looking For



Must-have:



- Strong Figma skills

- A good understanding of design, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and layout

- Creativity and the ability to develop ideas visually

- Fluent spoken and written English

- Good communication skills

- Proactive attitude

- Attention to detail

- Comfortable asking questions and requesting feedback

- Able to work independently when needed

- Able to overlap with European / Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST)



Big plus:



- Previous
 design experience

- Experience with Klaviyo

- Experience with Photoshop

- Experience with AI image generation

- Experience using AI for copywriting or creative workflows

- Experience with e-commerce or DTC brands

- Advanced Klaviyo knowledge such as dynamic blocks, personalization, or conditional content



Being Proactive Is Important



This is probably the most important part of the role besides being a good designer.



We don’t want someone who finishes an assigned task and then simply waits until another task appears.



If you have room in your schedule, look at what’s coming up. Ask what you can work on. Review previous designs. Bring an idea. Ask for feedback. Suggest something we could test or improve.



You don’t need to lead the strategy, but we do want you to contribute to it.



We want someone who becomes a genuine part of the team rather than someone we only communicate with when a design needs to be made.



About the Brand



You’ll be designing for our men’s belt brand.



We’ve recently expanded the brand with a completely new Outdoor collection, alongside our existing Classic collection. This gives us a lot of new products, photography, use cases, stories, and creative directions to work with.



We’re currently working on taking the overall
 design to the next level and making our campaigns more varied, visual, and interesting.



There’s plenty of room to experiment and bring new ideas into the brand.



How We Work



We use:

- Klaviyo for
 marketing

title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
description:
Purplefish is a well-funded tech startup based in New York City. We build software that does automated material and labor takeoff from piping isometric drawings for industrial contractors and pipe fabricators in the US. Our QA team already includes 2 amazing teammates in the Philippines who have been with us for over two years, and we're growing it.



REQUIRED: 

1) MUST have industrial piping estimation (quantity surveying and costing) experience including labor takeoff from piping ISOs.

2) Can work roughly 3-8pm EST, Mon-Thurs



THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL QUANTITY SURVEYING/ESTIMATION JOB. You'll use your estimation skills in a new way: checking the work of software instead of producing bids. It's a rare chance to sit at the intersection of tech and the trade you know. Your findings directly shape how the product improves every week, and you'll get deep exposure to how modern software is built while doing work only an experienced piping estimator can do.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- QA our software's take-offs from piping ISOs for our customers: find mistakes, missed items, and wrong counts

- Do independent manual labor take-offs from isometric drawing packages so we can compare results and measure accuracy. This means genuinely interpreting the ISO drawings, not just counting symbols



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Industrial Piping Estimators

- Real experience doing material AND labor takeoffs from piping isometrics (industrial work: oil and gas, chemical, power, process plants). Quantity surveying (QS) or mechanical engineering backgrounds welcome

- You can read ISOs, spool drawings, and spec sheets confidently: fittings, valves, welds, bolt-ups, pipe schedules. 

- Detail-obsessed. You enjoy finding the error nobody else caught

- Strong written and spoken English. You'll be explaining errors to a US engineering team

-Part time and full time are both a possibility





OUR HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will do a live takeoff assessment over video call, where you'll walk us through a take-off from a real ISO package and explain your reasoning as you go. This role requires genuine, demonstrated skill reading isometrics. Please only apply if you're confident doing this work live.



WHY JOIN

- Stable, long-term role with a funded company, not project work that dries up

- Work directly with the founders and engineering team

- Your expertise is the product's quality bar. This role has real influence



TO APPLY

Tell us briefly about your experience doing industrial piping estimation from ISOs, including weld counting. Also your preferred hours/time zone.

title: Sales & Estimating Coordinator – Landscaping | Aspire, GoHighLevel & AI
description:
Sales & Estimating Coordinator – Landscaping | Aspire, GoHighLevel & AI



IMPORTANT: LOOM VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY



Please do not apply until you have completed the Loom video instructions below.



We receive a high volume of applications and will only review candidates who submit the required Loom video with their application.



Your Loom video should be no longer than 5 minutes.



In your Loom video, please:



1. Introduce yourself and briefly explain your relevant work experience.

2. Tell us specifically about any experience you have with Aspire Landscape Software. If you have used Aspire, explain what you did inside the software.

3. Tell us about any experience you have with GoHighLevel and what you have built or managed within it.

4. Explain how you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT to make your work faster or better.

5. Imagine a salesperson sends you customer meeting notes, a meeting transcript, voice recordings, photos, measurements, and project instructions. Explain how you would take that information and turn it into a polished customer proposal.

6. Please share your screen for at least a portion of the Loom and show us a software, workflow, system, or project you are comfortable using. Do not show confidential information belonging to a current or previous employer.

7. Tell us about any other skills you have that may be valuable to our company.



We are not looking for a professionally produced video. We want to see how you communicate, think, organize information, and use technology.



Please do not simply read an AI-generated script.



Applications without the required Loom link will not be considered.



IMPORTANT WORK SCHEDULE:



This position requires you to be available and working during our normal business hours of 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.



Please make sure you are comfortable consistently working these hours before applying.



ABOUT THE POSITION



Local Landscapers is a growing landscaping and outdoor construction company in Virginia, USA.



We are looking for a highly organized, technology-focused Sales & Estimating Coordinator to support our sales team.



This is not a traditional data-entry Virtual Assistant position.



Our salespeople spend their time meeting customers, visiting properties, understanding projects, taking measurements, developing solutions, selecting materials, and making the technical decisions required to build a project.



We need someone behind them who can take that information and quickly turn it into an organized, professional, customer-ready proposal.



The goal is simple:



Our salesperson provides the knowledge and technical decisions. You help build the finished product.



Over time, we want the right person to become an important part of our sales operation and help us process more opportunities without sacrificing speed, accuracy, or proposal quality.



WORK SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available and actively working from 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.



This schedule is important because you will work directly with our U.S.-based sales team throughout the day. Our salespeople will be completing appointments and sending information to you so proposals can begin being built as quickly as possible.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working this schedule consistently and long term.



WHAT YOUR WORKFLOW MAY LOOK LIKE



A salesperson completes an appointment with a customer.



The meeting may be recorded and summarized using Otter.ai. The salesperson may also provide you with a Loom video, voice recording, photos, measurements, drawings, material selections, pricing information, and additional notes.



You will take that information and:



* Organize the customer's goals and project information

* Identify the individual services or line items being proposed

* Draft professional customer-facing scope descriptions

* Build and organize the proposal in Aspire

* Add appropriate photos, product information, drawings, and supporting materials

* Make sure the proposal clearly explains what is included and excluded

* Reference previous approved proposal templates and company standards

* Identify missing information instead of guessing

* Present the salesperson with a short, organized list of questions requiring their decision

* Prepare approximately 90% of the proposal for final salesperson review

* Make requested revisions quickly

* Help keep opportunities and follow-ups organized



Our goal is NOT for you to make technical landscaping or construction decisions that you are not qualified to make.



Our goal is for you to become extremely good at taking the salesperson's knowledge and turning it into a finished, polished sales package.



ASPIRE LANDSCAPE SOFTWARE



Experience with Aspire Landscape Software is STRONGLY PREFERRED.



If you have Aspire experience, we want to know specifically what you have done inside the platform, such as:



* Opportunities

* Estimating

* Proposals

* Catalog items

* Work tickets

* Customer information

* Scheduling/workflows

* Reporting

* Other Aspire functions



Aspire experience is a major advantage, but we will consider an exceptional candidate who demonstrates the ability to learn software quickly.



GOHIGHLEVEL



Experience with GoHighLevel is preferred.



As you grow into the position, you may also help us with:



* Sales pipelines

* Lead organization

* Automated
 and SMS follow-up

* Workflows and automations

* Tags and opportunity stages

* Unsold proposal follow-up

* Lead nurturing

* Old lead reactivation

* Marketing attribution

* Sales reporting

* CRM organization



You do not need to be an expert in every GoHighLevel feature on your first day.



AI IS PART OF THIS JOB



We actively use AI and want someone who is comfortable using it.



You should be able to use tools such as ChatGPT to help:



* Organize raw information

* Summarize meeting transcripts

* Draft proposal language

* Improve customer-facing writing

* Research products and materials

* Create repeatable templates

* Analyze information

* Improve workflows

* Work faster without sacrificing accuracy



We are not looking for someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers.



We want someone who knows how to give AI good information, review its output, catch mistakes, and turn it into useful finished work.



COMMUNICATION



This is a remote position, so strong asynchronous communication is extremely important.



Our company already uses Loom regularly.



You should be comfortable receiving instructions through:



* Loom videos

* Otter.ai transcripts and summaries

* Voice recordings

* Written notes

* Photos and videos

* Drawings

*
 and messaging



You should also be comfortable recording short Loom videos when showing us your work, asking a complicated question, or explaining an issue.



One of the most important skills for this position is knowing when you can figure something out yourself and when you need to ask the salesperson a question.



We do not want someone who guesses when important information is missing.



At the same time, we need someone who is resourceful and does not require constant supervision.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Are extremely comfortable working on a computer

* Work quickly and accurately

* Are highly organized

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Are comfortable learning new software

* Use AI regularly and intelligently

* Can take messy/raw information and organize it

* Can follow established systems and templates

* Can identify missing or conflicting information

* Are comfortable asking concise, specific questions

* Can work independently

* Enjoy building systems and improving processes

* Are interested in a long-term position where your responsibilities can grow

* Are able to consistently work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Experience supporting a landscaping, construction, home-service, estimating, or sales organization is a major plus.



SOFTWARE & SKILLS WE VALUE



Experience with any of the following should be mentioned in your application:



* Aspire Landscape Software – strongly preferred

* GoHighLevel

* ChatGPT / AI tools

* Otter.ai

* Loom

* Google Workspace

* Google Sheets / Excel

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Estimating software

* Proposal-building software

* Construction or landscaping software



You do NOT need experience with every program listed above.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful person in this role makes our salespeople more productive.



Instead of a salesperson spending significant time sitting at a computer building a proposal, we want them to be able to send you their information, move on to the next sales opportunity, and return later to a proposal that is approximately 90% complete.



A great handoff might look like:



"Proposal is ready for review. I need you to confirm these three technical questions. Everything else is complete."



We value:



Speed.

Accuracy.

Organization.

Initiative.

Excellent communication.

The ability to figure things out.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our company.



This position may begin primarily focused on proposal and estimating support, but the right person could eventually take significant ownership of our sales operations, including Aspire, GoHighLevel, proposal systems, follow-up systems, reporting, AI workflows, and supporting additional salespeople as our company grows.



There is room for increased responsibility and compensation as you demonstrate your value and take ownership of more of the sales process.



PAID SKILLS TEST



Candidates who perform well during the initial application process may be invited to complete a PAID skills test.



The test will closely resemble the actual work you would perform in this position.



You may receive items such as:



* Customer meeting information

* Salesperson notes

* Photos

* Measurements

* Voice/video instructions

* Project information



You will then be asked to organize the information and build part of a customer proposal.



We encourage the use of AI during the test.



We are interested in seeing the quality, accuracy, organization, judgment, and speed of your finished work.



HOW TO APPLY



STEP 1 – REQUIRED:



Record your Loom video using the instructions at the very top of this job posting.



STEP 2:



Send us:



* Your Loom link

* Your resume/CV

* A brief written introduction

* Your experience with Aspire, if any

* Your experience with GoHighLevel, if any

* Your current availability

* Your desired weekly compensation

* Confirmation that you can consistently work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please put the words "SALES OPS" at the beginning of your written application.



This helps us confirm that you carefully read the entire posting.



Again:



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A LOOM VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.



We are looking for someone who wants to become excellent at this position, learn our company, and grow with us long term.

title: Virtual Assistant & Shortform Video Editor (CapCut)
description:
I am a British-trained podiatrist based in Singapore. I run a clinic and I make video content about shoes and foot health for a large audience across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. I also work with footwear brands and I am building digital products.



I am looking for one organised, sharp assistant to take three things off my plate completely: my
 and calendar, the editing of my shortform videos, and my invoicing and admin.



This is a long term, full time role. I want someone who grows with the business, not someone passing through.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1.
 MANAGEMENT

- Triage my inbox at the start and end of each day. Sort, file, and flag what needs me.

- Draft replies in my voice for routine
 using an approved reply library.

- Spot brand partnership enquiries and get them in front of me fast. These are the most valuable
s I receive.

- Never give health or footwear advice in a reply. Anything about pain or injury gets escalated to me. This is a hard rule.



2. CALENDAR MANAGEMENT

- Own my calendar end to end. Book, move, confirm and remind.

- Protect my clinic days. Thursday and Friday stay clear of business meetings, always.

- Schedule across time zones with the UK, US and Australia, and confirm the time zone in writing every time.

- Send me a two week look ahead every Friday with any clashes flagged.



3. SHORTFORM VIDEO EDITING

This is a real editing job, not just captioning. Here is exactly how it works.

- I write a script and film to it. I hand you the script, the raw footage, and a folder of b-roll clips. The b-roll placements are already marked in the script, so you are not guessing.

- The raw footage has mistakes in it. Stumbles, restarts, two or three takes of the same line.

- You build the video in CapCut. Pick the strongest take of each line, cut the stumbles and dead air, get the pacing tight, and drop the b-roll in where I marked it.

- You caption it accurately. Shoe brand names and anatomy terms spelled correctly, every time.

- You export for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and
, then schedule and file it.

- You draft the first pass of the written caption and hashtags for me to approve.

- Volume is 3 finished videos per week. Shortform only. I do not need you cutting my long YouTube videos.



4. INVOICING AND ADMIN

- Pull invoices and receipts out of my inbox, name them properly, and upload them to our accounting portal.

- Keep the expense and invoice trackers current, and clear the backlog I have let build up.

- Raise my brand partnership invoices when a collaboration is delivered, then chase them politely until they are paid.

- Handle routine supplier
: shipping, sizes, addresses, sample tracking.

- Send me one short weekly summary so I never have to go looking for any of it.





WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written English. You will be writing as my business, so this is not negotiable.

- You can genuinely edit in CapCut, not just add captions. You can take messy raw footage and make it tight, and you can show me work you cut yourself.

- A feel for pacing. You know when a video is dragging and you fix it without being asked.

- A power user of Gmail and Google Calendar, including time zones, labels and filters.

- Real attention to detail. A typo in a caption goes out to a lot of people.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and admin detail. You notice when a number does not add up.

- You can work out what matters first without being told every time.

- Reliable. You communicate early and you own your mistakes.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience supporting a creator, a clinic or a personal brand.

- Familiarity with health, fitness or footwear content.

- Canva, scheduling tools, ManyChat or CRM experience.

- Any experience with bookkeeping or invoicing platforms.





THE DETAILS



- Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

- You need at least 6 hours of daily overlap with Singapore time, which is the same clock as Manila. Roughly 9am to 6pm.

- You need your own computer that can run CapCut on 1080p and 4K footage, and a stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps with a backup option.

- Pay starts at $750 USD per month. It rises to $900 from month 4 if you hit the targets we agree at your 90 day review, and $1,050 from month 13 once you own the role fully. Plus 13th month pay.

- I would rather pay well for the right person long term than cheaply for the wrong one.

- This role grows as the business grows. There is scope to take on more content and product work over time.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following in your application.



1. Start your application with the words FEET FIRST. If those words are not there, I will not read it. This is my first check that you follow instructions carefully.



2. Links to two shortform videos you edited yourself from raw footage. Tell me exactly what you did on each one. If you only added the captions and someone else cut it, say so. Honesty here matters more to me than the portfolio.



3. A short note, no more than 200 words, telling me which part of this role you are strongest at and which part you would need to learn.



4. Answer this in writing: you open my inbox on a Monday morning and there are 40 unread
s. What do you look for first, and why?



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a short paid test task before any offer is made. 



Thank you for reading this far.



Paul

title: Lead Video Editor & Motion Graphics Specialist (Cinematic YouTube / Ads)

title: Photo Culling & Retouching Specialist – Construction & Event Photography

We're open to AI-assisted tools for culling and batch retouching, as long as final quality holds up.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Cull event photo batches (~2,000 raw photos) down to a final select of 200-500 images per event

- Retouch photos to match a provided style guide or reference/inspiration images

- Apply consistent color correction and light retouching across construction/real estate photo sets (perspective correction, sky replacement where needed)

- Use AI-assisted culling/retouching tools where appropriate to speed up delivery, without compromising final quality

- Deliver final selects and retouched sets within 24 hours of receiving raw files

REQUIREMENTS:

- Strong skills in Adobe Lightroom (culling + batch editing) and Photoshop

- Experience with AI-assisted editing/culling tools (e.g. Lightroom AI tools, Aftershoot, Imagen AI, or similar) is a strong plus

- Comfortable working from a style reference/moodboard rather than fully detailed instructions

- Fast, organized workflow to handle high-volume event batches under time pressure

- Reliable high-speed internet for large file transfers via Google Drive



SCHEDULE: Notified minimum 1 week before each shoot/event date. 24-hour turnaround expected for final selects and retouched delivery. Volume varies: ~2,000 photos per event batch, smaller sets for construction shoots.



HOW TO APPLY: Start your application with "MWCAPTURE-PHOTO" at the top. Include:

1. Before/after retouching examples

2. Which AI-assisted tools you currently use, if any

3. Your expected rate (hourly or per-batch)

title: Graphic designer for Meta
description:
# E-commerce Graphic Designer — Meta Ads | Long-Term Role



**Salary: $6–$8/hour to start + opportunity to grow**

**Hours: 20–40 hours/week**

**Location: Remote — Philippines**

**Position: Long-term**



LumeWorks is a fast-growing Dutch e-commerce brand focused on projectors and home entertainment.



We're growing quickly, and we're looking for a talented Graphic Designer who wants to grow with us.



This is NOT a one-time freelance project.



We're looking for someone who can become a real part of our team for the long term.



If you're looking for stable, ongoing work where you can develop your skills, take on more responsibility and increase your compensation as you grow with the company, keep reading.



## Your main responsibility



Your #1 focus will be creating scroll-stopping static ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).



We don't just want beautiful designs.



We want designs that sell.



You'll turn creative concepts, references and marketing angles into ads that make people stop scrolling, understand the message and take action.



You'll also create:



* Static Meta ads

* Creative variations for A/B testing

* Social media content

* Website banners

* Product graphics

* Promotional campaigns

* Landing page visuals

* Other marketing assets



You'll work directly with our team and receive briefs, references, brand assets and feedback.



## We're NOT looking for someone who...



Simply opens Canva, picks a template and changes the text.



We're looking for someone who understands:



* Visual hierarchy

* Typography

* Composition

* Product presentation

* Direct-response advertising

* E-commerce

* Why some ads stop the scroll and others don't



Photoshop and/or Figma experience is strongly preferred.



Experience creating ads for DTC or e-commerce brands is a big advantage.



## What we expect from you



We move fast.



That means you need to be:



* Reliable

* Creative

* Fast

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable with feedback

* Able to meet deadlines

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Flexible when priorities change

* Available during weekends when needed



We don't expect you to work 7 days a week.



But e-commerce doesn't always run Monday to Friday. Occasionally, an important campaign, promotion or creative needs to be finished during the weekend.



We need someone who can be flexible when that happens.



## Why LumeWorks?



We're not building a team of random freelancers.



We want people who grow with us.



LumeWorks is growing quickly, and we want your role to grow with the company.



If you're great at what you do, there will be opportunities for:



* More responsibility

* More hours

* Higher compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Working on bigger campaigns

* Becoming a key member of our creative team



Your work won't disappear into a folder.



You'll see your designs launched in real advertising campaigns and learn which creatives actually generate sales.



That means you'll become a better performance designer, not just a better graphic designer.



And when you help us grow, we want you to benefit from that growth too.



## Compensation



**Starting rate: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience and portfolio.**



We're happy to increase compensation for people who consistently deliver great work and become more valuable to the company.



We're looking for a long-term relationship, so we'd rather reward great people and keep them with us than constantly hire new freelancers.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio

3. Your 5 best e-commerce / Meta ad designs

4. Which programs you use

5. Your experience with e-commerce brands

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. How many hours per week you're available

8. Your normal working hours in Philippine Time

9. Your availability during weekends



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word "CINEMA".



If your application doesn't start with CINEMA, we won't review it.



This is simply to make sure you've actually read the full job post.



### One final question:



What do you think makes a static
/Instagram ad convert?



There is no perfect answer.



We simply want to understand how you think.



If you're talented, ambitious, reliable and looking for a company where you can stay and grow for the long term, we'd love to hear from you.

We're excited to see what you can create.

title: E-commerce Product Researcher (Winning Dropshipping Products)
description:
We run e-commerce stores and we are hiring a Product Researcher to find winning dropshipping products every day. You will find high-potential, visually appealing products that are proven to sell, and source a fast-shipping supplier for each one.



Daily target: 5 winning products, each with a sourced supplier. Quality is the priority. We are not looking for generic products. We want items that genuinely have the potential to sell. Any product niche is fine, as long as it fits the parameters.



What we are looking for in each product:



WOW FACTOR

Visually striking, giftable, impulse-buy items that look great in photos and video. Good categories: LED night lights and lamps, novelty games (mini golf, claw machine, foosball), aesthetic home décor (jellyfish lamps, planters, photo frames), and viral beauty or pet gadgets. Avoid generic everyday items and anything medical or health-related.

Price and margin. Selling price $29.99 to $99.99 (best $29.99 to $49.99), with a supplier cost low enough to keep at least a 3x markup (ideally 4 to 5x).



SHIPPING

Supplier from a fast lane: AliExpress Choice or US/local warehouse, CJdropshipping US warehouse, Amazon, or Walmart. Delivery within 10 days, ideally under 7.



PROVEN BUT FRESH

Real ad traction that is still scaling. Around 50 to 500 active ads. Skip anything with 1,000+ ads or that has been mainstream for years.



CREATIVE READY

At least 5 good photos or videos available.



TEST TASK (REQUIRED)



Send a minimum of 3 products that fit the criteria above. For each one, include: product name, competitor/store link,
 Ad Library link and number of active ads, their selling price, supplier link and platform, supplier unit cost, estimated shipping time, and your markup (selling price divided by cost).



Skills we prefer:

Dropshipping or e-commerce product research experience

Familiar with AliExpress, CJdropshipping, AutoDS, and
/TikTok ad research

Fast, reliable, communicates daily



How to apply: Reply with your product research experience and your completed test task (the 3 products with details above). Applications with a finished test task will be prioritized.

title: Social Media Video Editor & Motion Designer
description:
Social Media Video Editor — Beauty & Lifestyle



Brazi Bronze is looking for a creative, social-first Video Editor to help bring our brand, products, and story to life across Instagram and TikTok.



We’re a Brazilian-inspired beauty brand focused on tanning, glowing skin, and clean, naturally derived beauty. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an editor who understands how to create content that doesn’t just look beautiful — it captures attention, tells a story, starts conversations, and builds community.



The Role



You’ll be responsible for editing short-form video content primarily for Instagram Reels and TikTok, working with footage provided by our team, founder, models, and content creators.



Our content will generally fall into two main categories:



Educational & Founder-Led Content



Talking-head videos featuring our founder discussing topics such as ingredients, tanning education, product benefits, Brazilian beauty traditions, the story behind Brazi Bronze, and behind-the-scenes moments of building the brand.



For this content, we’re looking for dynamic editing that keeps viewers engaged, including:



Animated text and captions



Motion graphics



Ingredient callouts and visual explanations



Images and video overlays



B-roll integration



Creative transitions



Pattern interrupts and visual hooks



Sound effects and music when appropriate



Strong pacing designed for viewer retention



The goal is to take educational or story-driven content and make it feel interesting, entertaining, approachable, and highly shareable.



Product & Editorial Content



We also create more visually driven beauty content featuring our products, models, application shots, skin, texture, tanning results, lifestyle imagery, and close-up product details.



These edits should feel elevated, warm, sensual, sun-kissed, and editorial while still being native to Instagram and TikTok.



Think beautiful product application, glowing skin, texture shots, close-ups, lifestyle moments, music-driven edits, and strong visual storytelling.



What We’re Looking For



We’d love to work with someone who:



Has strong experience editing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram



Understands social media trends without making every video feel overly trendy



Understands hooks, pacing, retention, and what keeps someone watching



Has excellent motion graphics and animation skills



Can make talking-head content visually engaging



Has a strong eye for beauty, skincare, fashion, or lifestyle content



Understands how to edit product-focused content with a more premium/editorial feel



Can create multiple editing styles while maintaining a consistent brand identity



Understands that the goal isn’t simply views — we want comments, shares, saves, conversations, and community growth



Is comfortable receiving creative direction while also bringing new ideas to the table



A Big Plus



Experience working with beauty, skincare, wellness, fashion, or lifestyle brands is highly preferred.



We’re especially interested in someone who actively follows TikTok and Instagram culture and can identify new editing styles, formats, hooks, and content opportunities that could work for our brand.



Our Goal



We want to build a stronger community around Brazi Bronze.



We’re looking for an editor who can help turn raw footage into content that makes people stop scrolling, watch, learn, comment, share, and become part of the conversation.



We don’t want every video to feel like an advertisement. Some should educate. Some should entertain. Some should tell our story. Some should simply make you want glowing, sun-kissed skin.



Ultimately, we want someone who can help us develop a recognizable Brazi Bronze content style across Instagram and TikTok.



To Apply



Please send:



Your portfolio or examples of short-form work



3–5 examples of TikTok/Reels you’ve edited



Examples of talking-head videos using animation or motion graphics



Examples of beauty, product, fashion, or editorial content, if available



The editing programs you use



Your typical turnaround time



Your rates



A short introduction telling us why you think you’d be a good fit for Brazi Bronze



Bonus: Send us 1–2 Instagram or TikTok accounts whose video editing/style you think is exceptional and tell us why.

title: Sr. Technical on-page SEO (GEO/AEO) Specialist: $7 to 9 per hour
description:
Senior Technical on-page SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) Specialist | Long-Term Remote



We are seeking a hands-on Technical SEO & GEO/AEO Specialist for a dedicated, long-term internal role.



This is an advanced technical and execution-focused position, not a general SEO or copywriting role. You will bridge traditional technical optimization with next-generation AI retrieval systems, optimizing our web architecture for Google, Bing, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and other LLM-driven answer engines.



Core Responsibilities

Technical Auditing & Execution: Perform deep-dive crawl, indexation, and architecture audits; resolve complex canonicalization, redirect chains, crawl-budget waste, and rendering bottlenecks.



AEO/GEO Implementation: Structure on-page content, semantic entities, and data models to maximize citation and retrieval rates in AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot).



Entity SEO & Semantic Schema: Write, test, and deploy nested JSON-LD structured data models (Organization, Service, Article, FAQ, ItemList, Product) mapped to recognized entities and knowledge graphs.



Performance & Core Web Vitals: Diagnose and resolve CWV issues (LCP, INP, CLS) alongside site speed and server response bottlenecks.



Hands-on Technical Fixes: Directly implement or debug basic HTML/CSS, CMS configurations (WordPress/custom setups), robots.txt, XML sitemaps, and tag firing.



Tracking & Diagnostics: Track organic performance, index coverage, and LLM brand/entity visibility using Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, log analyzers, and GEO monitoring tools.



Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

3+ Years of Proven Technical SEO Experience: Demonstrated ability to fix complex crawlability, rendering (JavaScript SEO), and indexing challenges.



Demonstrated AEO/GEO Proficiency: Strong understanding of how LLMs parse, index, and cite content (RAG pipelines, entity extraction, natural language search intent).



Advanced JSON-LD Schema: Ability to manually write, debug, and implement custom multi-layer schema beyond default plugin outputs.



Front-End Competence: Working proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, and basic JavaScript to apply fixes independently without relying entirely on external developers.



Proficiency with Industry Tools: Advanced mastery of Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush, Sitebulb, and log analysis tools.



Analytical & Clear Communication: Fluent professional English (written) with the ability to document actionable technical specifications clearly.



Trial & Confidentiality Terms

Paid Technical Trial: Shortlisted candidates will complete a structured, paid technical assessment to evaluate real-world diagnostic skills, code implementation, and turnaround time.



Strict NDA Required: This project is strictly confidential; signing a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement is mandatory prior to trial onboarding.



Execution-First Focus: We prioritize specialists who can diagnose and directly fix technical issues over theoretical auditors.



Application Questionnaire

Please include concise answers to the following 7 targeted questions with your application:



Background & Tooling: Briefly summarize your technical SEO background and list your daily tech stack (crawlers, validators, monitoring tools).



AEO/GEO Strategy: How do you approach optimizing a page for AI/LLM retrieval and answer engine visibility compared to traditional SERPs?



Structured Data: Describe a complex JSON-LD schema hierarchy you manually wrote and deployed (e.g., nesting 
 linking).



Hands-on Implementation: What front-end/CMS tasks can you execute yourself (e.g., editing template files, CSS tweaks, script deferrals) vs. needing a full developer?



Real-World Win: Briefly describe a specific technical/crawlability issue you diagnosed and solved, including the measurable outcome.



Availability & Target Compensation: How many dedicated hours per day can you commit, and what is your expected monthly rate (USD)?



Trial & NDA: Confirm your readiness to sign an NDA and complete a paid technical assessment.



How to Apply

Submit your proposal with your questionnaire answers and a single Google Drive folder link (set to "Anyone with the link can view") containing:



Current Resume / CV



Redacted Technical SEO Audit Sample (identifying root causes + implementation steps)



Custom Schema / JSON-LD Code Samples



GEO/AEO or Entity Optimization Case Study / Proof of Results



NOTE: Applications without direct answers to the screening questions or technical work samples will not be reviewed.

title: 3D STL Mesh Repair & 3D Printing Assistant
description:
I need someone experienced with 3D printing files to help prepare STL/3MF/OBJ models for printing.



The first job is straightforward: I have existing 3D models that need to be resized, repaired, oriented correctly, and exported as clean printable files without damaging the geometry.



You should know how to:



• Resize STL/OBJ/3MF meshes to exact dimensions

• Repair broken/non-manifold meshes

• Reduce extremely large mesh/file sizes without destroying important detail

• Check wall thickness

• Make models watertight/manifold

• Fix models that are not sitting correctly on the build plate

• Separate or combine mesh parts when necessary

• Correct orientation for 3D printing

• Prepare models for FDM and resin printing

• Export clean STL and 3MF files

• Preserve as much original detail as possible



Software experience with Blender, Meshmixer, Fusion 360, Rhino, Netfabb, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, Lychee, Chitubox or similar tools is useful.



I use both FDM and resin 3D printers, so understanding actual printability is important. I do NOT only need someone who knows how to visually resize an object. You need to understand meshes and how changing a model affects the finished print.



For the first paid test, I will provide one problem 3D file and the dimensions I need.



You will return:



1. Original-quality repaired model

2. Resized printable STL

3. 3MF version when appropriate

4. Recommended print orientation

5. Short explanation of any problems you found in the original mesh



If the first project goes well, there will be ongoing work involving fashion accessories, jewelry, combs, wearable products, prototypes, product development and preparation of models for manufacturing.



When applying, please send:



• Examples of STL/mesh repair work

• Software you use

• Your experience preparing models for 3D printing

• Whether you understand both resin and FDM printing

• Your price for repairing/resizing one test file



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “MESH READY” so I know you read the entire job description.

title: Creator Partnerships Manager (Part-Time)
description:
Creator Partnerships Manager (Part-Time, Remote)



Type: Part-time, 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday to Friday) Salary: $450 – $600 USD/month, depending on experience.





ABOUT US

We are a European e-commerce brand selling personalised jewelry. Small team, direct communication, everything in English.



We run a creator program where content creators receive free product, make short-form video, and earn commission on the sales their content generates. It works. It just needs someone who runs it properly, every day.





THE ROLE

You own our creator program end to end.



Managing the creator pipeline. Every creator moves through a number of stages before their first video goes live. You keep track of exactly where each one is, follow up on a fixed rhythm, and chase our suppliers when a sample is delayed. You tell the creator what's happening before they have to ask.



Finding new creators. You get a fixed number of invitations to send every working day, and you use all of them. Not on the biggest accounts, on the right ones: clean natural-light filming, strong close-up work, an audience that actually engages.



Reviewing video. This is where the job gets interesting. Every video is checked against our written standard before it goes live. Clear yes or no, and when it's a no you tell the creator exactly what to change. The founder reviews alongside you for the first two weeks so you learn what we look for. After that it's yours.



Seasonal campaigns. Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day. You set these up in advance and brief our best creators, so the content exists before the season starts instead of during it.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We can teach you our product. We can teach you our platform. We cannot teach you attention to detail.



The person we want notices that the hook lands at four seconds instead of two. That the product goes out of focus in the third shot. That a creator's last three posts got half the engagement of the ones before. That the tracker says "shipped" but the tracking number never moved.



Most people watch a video and say "nice, good lighting". We are looking for the person who says "no, and here is exactly why, and here is what to change".



That is the whole job. Everything else is process.





REQUIRED

- 2+ years managing creators, influencers or affiliate partners for a brand or agency

- Excellent written English. You write to creators in the US and Europe every day and it has to sound human

- A genuine eye for video. You can watch ten seconds and name what works and what doesn't

- Self-managing. You track things without being asked and follow up without being reminded

- Comfortable in Google Sheets



A plus:

- Experience with a creator platform such as Trybe, Aspire, GRIN or similar

- E-commerce or Shopify background

- Jewelry, fashion or beauty



Not needed:

- You do not edit video yourself





WHO THIS SUITS

Nobody will hand you a daily task list. You get clear targets and freedom in how you hit them.



Creators are busy and get approached by a lot of brands. If following up with someone for the third time makes you uncomfortable, this will frustrate you. If you enjoy turning a quiet list into an active one, you will like it here.





HOW TO APPLY

We get a lot of applications and most of them are clearly written by AI. We can tell, and it never works in your favour. We would rather read three honest sentences from you than three polished paragraphs from a chatbot.



So skip the cover letter. Just tell us two things, in your own words:



One brand where you managed creators. How many, over what period, and what you did about the ones who went quiet. Numbers help.



Why you think you are the right person for this one. Not why you want a job. Why this one.



Write it like you would explain it to someone over coffee. That is all we need to start a conversation.

title: AI Automation & Implementation Specialist
description:
AI AUTOMATION & IMPLEMENTATION SPECIALIST



We are looking for an experienced AI Automation & Implementation Specialist who can help us identify, design, and implement AI-powered systems across our business.



IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Please apply only if you have proven, hands-on experience in AI automation and business implementation.



This is NOT a beginner, entry-level, or training position. We are looking for someone who already knows what they are doing and can work with minimal supervision.



The ideal candidate should be able to understand a business problem, identify opportunities for automation, recommend the right tools or approach, and independently implement practical AI solutions.



We are NOT looking for someone whose experience is mainly using ChatGPT for content creation, prompting, or basic AI tasks.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The goal is to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive manual work, improve how we handle customer and product inquiries, manage general business inquiries, and help our team work more efficiently.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for AI automation.

• Design and implement AI-powered workflows that solve real business problems.

• Develop automation for customer and product inquiries across different channels.

• Explore and implement AI-powered phone/voice solutions for incoming calls.

• Build AI agents, chatbots, and other intelligent systems where appropriate.

• Connect AI systems with existing business platforms, CRM systems, Shopify, websites,
, databases, and other tools.

• Automate lead capture, qualification, routing, follow-ups, notifications, and internal workflows.

• Use AI to streamline repetitive administrative and operational processes.

• Research and recommend AI tools and technologies that could improve business efficiency.

• Integrate systems using APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms.

• Test, troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve automation workflows.

• Document implemented systems and processes.

• Work closely with management to understand business requirements and recommend practical AI solutions.



EXAMPLES OF POTENTIAL PROJECTS



The initial projects may include, but are not limited to:



• AI-powered phone/voice agents for customer and general business inquiries

• AI customer service and product inquiry systems

• Automated lead capture and qualification

• Automated CRM updates and lead routing

• AI-powered
 and inquiry handling

• Automated customer follow-ups

• Internal AI assistants and knowledge bases

• Automating repetitive administrative and operational processes

• Connecting different business systems so information flows automatically between them



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience implementing AI automation for businesses.

• Strong understanding of business process automation and workflow design.

• Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation workflows.

• Experience with one or more platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar tools.

• Experience working with APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

• Experience with AI platforms/APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar.

• Experience building AI agents, chatbots, or AI-powered workflows.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Ability to understand a business process and determine how it can be improved or automated.

• Ability to work independently and recommend solutions rather than simply waiting for instructions.

• Strong communication skills.



STRONGLY PREFERRED



Experience with:



• AI voice agents and phone automation

• AI agent development

• RAG and AI knowledge bases

• CRM integrations and automation

• Shopify or e-commerce integrations

• Customer service and lead automation

• REST APIs and webhooks

• Database integrations

• Workflow monitoring and error handling

• JavaScript, Python, or other programming languages

• Platforms such as Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs, Twilio, or similar tools



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION



We are looking for someone with REAL-WORLD IMPLEMENTATION EXPERIENCE.



You should be able to:



• Understand a business problem.

• Identify what can and should be automated.

• Recommend the appropriate AI tools, platforms, and approach.

• Build and implement the solution.

• Test and troubleshoot the automation.

• Monitor and improve the system over time.



We do not expect you to know every AI platform available. However, you should have a strong understanding of AI automation and integrations and be able to research and implement the right solution when needed.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



When applying, please provide:



1. Examples of AI automation projects you have personally built and implemented.

2. A brief explanation of the business problem each automation solved.

3. The tools, platforms, APIs, and technologies used.

4. Your specific role and responsibilities in the implementation.

5. Portfolio links, screenshots, videos, documentation, or other evidence of your work, if available.

6. A brief explanation of how you would approach automating customer and product inquiries for a business like ours.



Applications without relevant hands-on AI automation experience may not be considered.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can look at a business process, identify opportunities for improvement, and turn those opportunities into practical, reliable AI-powered systems.



We want someone who can TAKE OWNERSHIP of AI automation projects and implement solutions with MINIMAL SUPERVISION.
