title: Money & Personal Finance News Writer
description:
We are looking for reliable, detail-oriented Money & Personal Finance News Writers to join our growing editorial team. This role focuses on personal finance, money-related news, consumer issues, global markets, economic trends, and major world events that impact people’s finances.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of personal finance and economic topics and can quickly turn complex money-related stories into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly articles.



Work Schedule:



4:00 PM to 12:00 AM (Philippine Time)

Monday to Friday



Key Responsibilities:



> Write 4 original money/finance news articles per day

> Cover topics such as personal finance, Social Security, taxes, retirement, loans, savings, credit, investments, banking, cost of living, inflation, consumer finance, stock market trends, and major economic developments

> Cover major US and global news events that have an impact on consumers' money and financial decisions

> Translate complex financial and economic news into easy-to-understand, reader-friendly content

> Monitor breaking news, financial updates, economic developments, consumer trends, and money-related discussions

> Research stories using credible financial, government, business, and international news sources

> Monitor Reddit and relevant online communities to identify trending money topics, reader concerns, discussions, and potential story angles

> Use Reddit as a source for identifying trends and public sentiment while independently verifying information through credible sources

> Fact-check all information before submission to ensure accuracy and credibility

> Write clear, engaging, and well-structured articles tailored to a broad audience

> Create compelling, SEO-friendly headlines with strong click-through potential

> Identify timely and relevant financial angles that can attract readers

> Follow editorial guidelines and consistently meet daily deadlines



Requirements:



> At least 2 years of experience in personal finance writing, business writing, journalism, finance blogging, or digital publishing

> Strong English writing and grammar skills

> Solid understanding of personal finance, including loans, savings, credit, investments, retirement, taxes, Social Security, and cost-of-living issues

> Good awareness of US and global economic trends, financial markets, and major business news

> Ability to quickly identify newsworthy stories and financial angles that matter to everyday readers

> Strong research and fact-checking skills using reliable financial, government, and news sources

> Comfortable covering breaking news and fast-moving financial and economic developments

> Ability to simplify complex financial topics into clear, engaging content

> Familiarity with Reddit and relevant subreddits, with the ability to identify trending discussions and potential story ideas

> Understanding that Reddit should be used primarily for trend discovery, reader sentiment, and story leads, with claims independently verified through credible sources

> Ability to work independently and manage daily article output

> Experience with online publishing platforms or CMS is a plus



What We’re Looking For: 



> Strong interest in money, personal finance, business, and the economy

> High level of accuracy and attention to detail

> Strong headline-writing skills with a high CTR focus

> Ability to produce fast, high-quality content under tight deadlines

> Good editorial judgment and understanding of what drives reader engagement in money and finance content

> Ability to spot interesting and timely financial stories before they become mainstream

> Familiarity with Reddit trends and online discussions

> Consistency, reliability, and self-discipline



Ideal Candidate Profile: 



You are someone who:

> Follows US financial news, economic developments, and money trends daily

> Understands how economic and political developments can affect people's money and financial decisions

> Knows how to find interesting and timely story ideas from news sites, Reddit, and online discussions

> Can turn breaking financial news and trending discussions into engaging, informative articles quickly

> Can distinguish between a viral topic and a genuinely newsworthy financial story

> Writes with clarity, authority, and purpose — not fluff



Why Join Us:



If you’re passionate about personal finance, money, economics, and current events — and can consistently deliver accurate, engaging, and high-impact content — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO – Full-Time, US Hours
description:
Salary: ₱55,000–₱75,000/month, depending on experience

Hours: Monday–Friday, We are flexible on exact working hours, but there must be consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. We are open to either U.S. business hours or a Philippines daytime schedule with U.S. afternoon/evening overlap.

Location: Remote – Philippines



We are a growing US-based service company looking for a sharp, highly organized Executive Assistant to work directly with the CEO.



This is not primarily a calendar-management role, and we are not looking for someone who needs detailed instructions for every task.



The goal of this position is simple: take work off the CEO's plate.



You'll start by taking ownership of administrative and operational tasks that currently require the CEO's attention. As you learn the company, we want you to become increasingly independent—identifying what needs to be done, handling it, and closing the loop without needing to be asked.



What You'll Work On



Your responsibilities will include:



- Managing the CEO's
 and handling messages that don't require his direct involvement

- Drafting and sending
 responses

- Following up with employees, candidates, vendors, and others until outstanding items are resolved

- Creating and managing Indeed job postings

- Communicating with job candidates throughout the hiring process

- Collecting onboarding information and making sure new hires complete required steps

- Assisting with employee onboarding and HR administration

- Transferring and maintaining employee information across payroll, benefits, retirement, and other systems

- Maintaining accurate company records and databases, including vehicle information

- Updating Airtable and other company systems

- Making occasional phone calls to US-based employees, candidates, or vendors

- Researching administrative or operational questions and recommending a solution

- Handling miscellaneous projects that would otherwise require the CEO's time



This Role Will Constantly Evolve



One thing you should know before applying: this will not be the same job six months from now that it is on Day 1.



Our company is growing, and the CEO's needs change frequently. You'll learn new systems, take ownership of new responsibilities, and sometimes stop doing things that are no longer important.



We don't expect you to know how to do everything when you start. We do expect you to be comfortable learning, adapting, and figuring things out.



If you prefer a highly predictable role with the same responsibilities and processes every day, this probably isn't the right position for you.



If you enjoy becoming the person who can be handed something new and say, "I'll figure it out," you'll likely do very well here.



As you demonstrate good judgment and reliability, we'll continue moving more responsibility to you. For an exceptional performer, this role could eventually grow beyond a traditional Executive Assistant position into a broader operations or leadership role.



Who We're Looking For



You should have:



- At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent follow-through

- Good judgment

- Comfort communicating professionally with US-based employees and job candidates

- Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly

- Experience working independently in a remote environment

- Ability to work US Eastern Time hours



Experience with recruiting, HR administration, Indeed, Airtable, or similar systems is a plus, but not required.



The Most Important Part



We are looking for someone who can figure things out.



If you're given an assignment you've never done before, your first instinct should be to investigate, find the answer, and move the project forward—not immediately ask your manager what to do.



That doesn't mean you should never ask questions. Good judgment includes knowing when a question is necessary.



But this position will not be a good fit for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every assignment.



A great Executive Assistant makes their executive's life easier. After working together for a while, we want to be able to send you a short message explaining an outcome we need and trust you to take it from there.



What Success Looks Like



After your first few months:



- Fewer administrative
s require the CEO's involvement.

- Candidates receive quick and professional communication.

- Hiring and onboarding tasks don't fall through the cracks.

- Company databases and employee records stay current.

- Outstanding items are followed up on without reminders.

- When you're given a problem, you usually return with a solution rather than another task for the CEO.



For an exceptional performer, there is significant opportunity to take on additional operational responsibility as the company continues to grow.



How to Apply



Please apply with the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.



2. Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.



3. Your current work situation and when you could start.



4. Your experience working with U.S.-based companies, including any experience working U.S. hours, and your preferred working hours (please include your time zone).



5. Answer the following scenario:



You receive this message from the CEO:



"One of our company vehicles apparently has an expired registration. Brandon says he can't renew it online and it needs to be handled at the NJ DMV. Can you figure out what we need to do and get this moving?"



In your response, explain what you would do next. We are more interested in how you approach the problem than whether you already know anything about vehicle registration.



6. Begin your application with the words "I like figuring things out." This lets us know you read the entire posting.



Please do not use ChatGPT or another AI tool to write your response to question #5. We want to understand how you personally think and communicate.

Your job: draw new cover templates, full-time, that extend one single collection.



The aesthetic bar is the whole job.

Our collection looks like it came from one hand. Every new template has to be the next one in that family, not a different artist's take on the brief. We work by restraint: nothing to add, nothing to remove. Detail is an accent, never the subject.



Every cover gets a binary verdict: it's a wow, or it goes back. There is no "good enough."



This is you if:

- You apply a style guide instead of arguing with it.

- You'd rather go deep on one brand for years than jump between clients.

- You read a reference and see the rule behind it, not just the picture.



Non-negotiable:

- Full-time, long-term. This is not a gig.

- Working English.

title: Owner
description:
VitalAir Sleep and Lung Center is a new pulmonary and sleep medicine practice in Frisco, Texas. We are seeking one experienced, dependable Medical Virtual Assistant to become our full-time remote front-office coordinator.



This is a long-term position supporting one physician at launch. A second provider may join the practice in early 2027.



Schedule:

• Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Central Time

• 40 hours per week

• This is an overnight schedule in the Philippines



Primary responsibilities:

• Answer patient calls professionally and manage messages

• Schedule, reschedule and confirm appointments

• Complete patient registration and collect required forms

• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits

• Track referrals and prior authorizations

• Manage electronic faxes, medical records and administrative inboxes

• Follow up with patients, referring offices, insurance companies and vendors

• Maintain accurate task lists and document all follow-up

• Escalate clinical questions appropriately without providing medical advice

• Assist with general front-office and practice-launch tasks



Required qualifications:

• At least two years of experience supporting a U.S. medical practice

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Professional, warm and confident phone presence

• Experience with EHR scheduling, insurance verification, referrals, prior authorizations and medical records

• Strong organization, attention to detail and follow-through

• Private and quiet workspace

• Reliable wired internet, backup internet and backup power

• Professional headset

• Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality

• Proven ability to work a permanent overnight schedule reliably



Preferred:

• AthenaOne/Athenahealth experience

• RingCentral experience

• Pulmonary, sleep medicine, specialty practice or DME experience

• Experience helping launch or organize a new medical practice



Compensation:

$5–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience. A 13th-month bonus will be offered after successful completion of the introductory period.



How to apply:

Please include:



1. A brief description of your U.S. medical-office experience

2. The EHR systems you have used

3. Your experience with insurance verification and prior authorizations

4. Confirmation that you can permanently work 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Central Time

5. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing how you would handle an upset patient whose appointment needs to be rescheduled

6. The words “VitalAir Front Office” at the beginning of your application



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: AI Video Editor — DTC Supplement Brand (part-time, remote)
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC health brand running paid social at scale. We need an editor who can turn winning ad concepts into new, native AI videos — not someone who just re-cuts stock footage.



You do not need to figure out our ad strategy yourself. We will train you on exactly how we want our ads built, how we research winning concepts, how we structure creatives, and what makes an ad a winner for our brand. You'll get clear examples, frameworks, feedback, and direction from our team.



You'll be doing:



* Building our video ad engine: recreating proven winning concepts from competitors, indirect competitors, and TikTok Shop natively — with new B-rolls, AI avatars, cloned voices, and fresh executions so every ad feels original.



* Turning our winning long-form static scripts into videos (talking-head / VSL / movie-credit style).



* Fast iteration: producing multiple new video variations every week.



* Following our proven creative frameworks and turning our direction into high-quality finished ads.



Must-haves (non-negotiable):



* Proven experience editing ads for other DTC / e-commerce brands.

* A portfolio showing paid-social creatives you've made for real brands.

* Strong hands-on experience with HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, and Veo3.

* Able to create your own AI B-rolls, including realistic product-in-hand swaps.

* Able to recreate winning concepts without simply copying or re-cutting existing footage.

* Able to take direction, follow creative frameworks, and implement feedback quickly.

* Fast communication and reliable turnaround.



Nice to have:



* Experience specifically with supplements, health, wellness, or other direct-response products.



Pay:



Starts at $5/hr, with a performance bonus from month 2 based on winning ads.



How to apply:



Send a short message with:



1. Your portfolio, including examples of ads you've edited for other DTC/e-commerce brands.

2. Which AI tools you use and exactly how you use them in your workflow.



Start your message with the words "A player" so we know you actually read this!

title: Shopify product lister/video editor
description:
Shopify Product Lister & Video Editor



We are a young and fast-growing e-commerce company looking for a Shopify Product Lister with strong video editing skills to join our team.



We are ambitious, move quickly, test new ideas constantly, and are building a team of people who want to grow with us.



This is not a simple copy-paste product listing role.



We are looking for someone who understands how a product should be presented online, knows Shopify very well, can improve product images and videos, and understands that every product page and creative should help turn visitors into customers.



What You Will Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be launching and improving products in our Shopify stores.



Your tasks will include:



* Creating complete product listings in Shopify

* Writing and formatting product descriptions

* Setting up variants, pricing, product options, collections and tags

* Uploading and improving product images

* Creating and editing product GIFs and visual content

* Checking supplier information carefully before publishing

* Improving existing product pages

* Adapting product pages based on successful competitors and proven examples

* Translating and adapting creatives for different markets

* Editing product videos for advertisements and product pages

* Creating stronger hooks for existing videos

* Turning English-language videos into videos suitable for another market

* Adding or replacing text, subtitles, voice-overs and visual elements

* Creating more problem/solution-focused openings for advertising creatives

* Using AI tools to work faster while maintaining a high standard of quality



Shopify Experience Is a Must!



You should already be comfortable working independently inside Shopify.



You should understand things such as:



* Product listings

* Variants

* Collections

* Product images

* Product descriptions

* Basic SEO

* Product page structure

* Conversion-focused presentation



Experience with e-commerce or dropshipping companies is a strong advantage.



Video Editing Is Important



We are specifically looking for someone who can do more than basic product listing.



You should be comfortable editing existing product videos and turning them into stronger creatives.



For example:



An English product video may need to be adapted into another language.



A weak first 3 seconds may need a completely new hook.



A general product video may need to become more focused on the customer's problem and the solution the product offers.



You don't need to be a Hollywood video editor.



You do need to understand **what makes people stop scrolling and continue watching**.



Experience with tools such as **CapCut, Clipchamp, Higgsfield or similar video-editing and AI tools** is a big advantage.



You Must Have Your Own Tools



We expect you to already have access to the tools you need to do your work efficiently.



For example:



* ChatGPT or similar AI tools

* Canva, Photoshop, Photoroom or similar image-editing tools

* CapCut, Clipchamp or similar video-editing software

* AI image and video-generation tools such as Higgsfield or similar platforms



We are always experimenting with new tools, so being curious about AI and new technology is very important to us.



Who We Are Looking For



You will probably fit well with us if you are:



* Experienced with Shopify

* Comfortable editing both images and videos

* Marketing-minded

* Very detail-oriented

* Fast but accurate

* Independent

* Curious and eager to learn

* Comfortable receiving feedback

* Interested in e-commerce and online marketing

* Good at following systems and examples

* Proactive when you see something that could be improved

* Reliable and able to finish what you start



We are a results-driven team.



We care about speed, but quality matters just as much.



We want people who are excited to learn new skills, improve every week and take on more responsibility as the company grows.



Working Hours & Compensation



This is a part-time remote position.



You will normally work around:



2–3 hours per day on average



Starting compensation:



$3–$4 USD per hour, depending on your experience and skills.



You will start with a one-month paid traineeship.



During this month, we will work closely together and see how well we match in terms of quality, communication, speed and working style.



After the first month, we will evaluate the cooperation together.



For strong performers, there will be opportunities to:



* continue long-term

* increase responsibilities

* develop new skills

* grow within the company

* increase compensation as your contribution grows



What We Offer



* Fully remote work

* Flexible part-time hours

* Weekly payments

* Hands-on experience in a growing e-commerce company

* Daily experience with Shopify, AI, creative production and digital marketing

* Opportunity to grow together with the company

* Room to test ideas and improve systems

* A young, ambitious and informal team



We are building for the long term and would love to find someone who wants to grow with us rather than simply complete tasks.



IMPORTANT – Portfolio Required



Please do not apply without examples of your previous work.



Every application must include:



1. Shopify portfolio



Please send examples of Shopify stores, product pages or product listings you have created or worked on.



If your previous client work is confidential, screenshots are completely fine.



Please explain briefly what you personally did on each project.



2. Video editing portfolio



Please send examples of videos you have personally edited.



We are especially interested in:



* E-commerce product videos

* Meta/Facebook/TikTok-style advertisements

* Videos where you changed the hook

* Videos translated or adapted into another language

* Before-and-after examples

* UGC-style creatives

* AI-assisted video editing



Please tell us which tools you used.



3. Tools



Tell us which tools you currently have access to for:



* Shopify

* Image editing

* Video editing

* AI image generation

* AI video generation



## One Final Detail



Attention to detail is extremely important for this position.



To show us that you have read the complete job description, start your application with:



“The devil is in the details.”



Then send us:



* Your Shopify experience

* Your Shopify portfolio

* Your video-editing portfolio

* The tools you use

* Your current hourly rate

* Your availability

* Why you think you would be a strong addition to our team



We receive many applications, so applications with clear portfolios and real examples will receive priority.



If you are hungry to learn, comfortable working hard, excited about e-commerce and want to grow together with an ambitious team, we would love to hear from you.



Ready for the next step? Apply and show us what you can do.



We are really looking forward to hear from you!

title: B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller / Contact Researcher Remote — Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
# B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller / Contact Researcher



### Remote — Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity



**Company:** Growing U.S.-based consumer and corporate gifting brands

**Position:** B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller / Contact Researcher

**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Employment:** Part-Time or Full-Time

**Compensation:** Competitive monthly base + performance bonuses



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller / Contact Researcher** to join our growing sales team.



We already have targeted lists of U.S. companies that may have a need for our products. Your job will be to take those companies and turn them into **qualified conversations and sales appointments**.



You will research the correct decision-makers, make professional outbound calls, qualify prospects, follow up, and schedule appointments with our owner/sales closer.



Our brands operate in the **beauty, wellness, luxury, fitness, and corporate gifting** markets.



## What You Will Do



### Contact Research



* Take our existing list of target companies

* Research the appropriate decision-maker

* Find HR Directors, HR Managers, People Operations, Office Managers, Procurement Managers, Executive Assistants, Marketing Managers, and business owners

* Find accurate business phone numbers,
s, and LinkedIn profiles

* Use LinkedIn, Google, Apollo.io, and other research tools

* Keep prospect information accurate and organized



### Cold Calling



* Make professional outbound B2B calls

* Introduce our corporate gifting solutions

* Speak with decision-makers

* Ask qualifying questions

* Identify companies with current or upcoming gifting opportunities

* Handle common objections professionally

* Follow up with prospects who request additional information



### Appointment Setting



Your primary objective is to schedule **qualified sales appointments**.



You will coordinate meetings with our owner/sales closer when a prospect has legitimate interest.



We are looking for **quality appointments—not just a high number of calls.**



## Ideal Prospect



You may be contacting companies looking for:



* Employee appreciation gifts

* Employee wellness gifts

* Holiday/corporate gifts

* Client appreciation gifts

* Executive gifts

* Employee onboarding gifts

* Corporate event gifts

* Wellness program gifts

* Bulk gifting solutions



## Required Experience



You MUST have:



* Previous B2B cold-calling experience

* Appointment-setting experience

* Strong spoken English

* Professional phone presence

* Experience researching business contacts

* Experience using LinkedIn

* Strong follow-up skills

* CRM experience

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable internet and a quiet professional workspace



### Strongly Preferred



Experience with:



* Apollo.io

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* HubSpot

* Zoho CRM

* Google Sheets

*
 outreach

* Corporate gifting

* Promotional products

* B2B sales

* Wellness products

* Luxury products



## Performance Expectations



Initial targets:



**50–75 outbound calls per working day**



**Accurate decision-maker research**



**Consistent follow-up**



**3–8 qualified appointments per week**



These are initial performance targets and may increase as the sales system is optimized.



You will be evaluated based on:



**Quality conversations → Qualified prospects → Appointments booked → Appointments held → Sales opportunities**



We are NOT interested in someone who simply makes calls all day without producing results.



## Compensation



We offer a **competitive monthly base salary plus performance incentives.**



Additional bonuses may be available for:



* Qualified appointments that are held

* Consistent weekly performance

* Sales opportunities generated

* Closed business



Top performers will have the opportunity for increased compensation and additional responsibility.



## Work Schedule



You must be available to work during **U.S. business hours** because you will be contacting American companies.



Your specific schedule will be discussed during the interview.



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Confident

* Persistent

* Professional

* Organized

* Coachable

* Results-oriented

* Comfortable making cold calls

* Comfortable speaking with executives and managers

* Able to follow a sales process

* Motivated by performance



We are looking for someone interested in building a **long-term relationship**, not a short-term gig.



## How To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



**1.** Tell us about your B2B cold-calling experience.



**2.** How many years have you worked in B2B sales or appointment setting?



**3.** What types of companies or decision-makers have you contacted?



**4.** What was your average number of calls per day?



**5.** How many qualified appointments were you typically booking per week?



**6.** Which CRM systems have you used?



**7.** Do you have experience with Apollo.io? Explain.



**8.** Do you have experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator? Explain.



**9.** What U.S. time-zone hours are you available to work?



**10.** What monthly compensation are you seeking?



### IMPORTANT:



Please include a **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit for this position.



Candidates without the requested voice recording may not be considered.



## Interview Process



Shortlisted candidates will complete:



**Step 1:** Application review



**Step 2:** Video/phone interview



**Step 3:** Mock B2B cold call



**Step 4:** Paid trial period



We are looking for a salesperson who can demonstrate results—not simply talk about sales experience.



**If you are confident on the phone, experienced with B2B prospecting, and enjoy booking qualified sales appointments, we want to hear from you.**

title: Social Media Manager & Digital Marketing Specialist — Events/Nightlife Brand
description:
We're hiring a full-time Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist to own our social presence and paid digital advertising end-to-end. This is not an entry-level content-scheduling role — we need someone who can independently plan strategy, manage real ad budgets, and make fast creative judgment calls, especially around our event schedule.



Responsibilities:



Own the content calendar and posting strategy across social platforms

Write captions, copy, and direct static graphic creation

Manage community engagement, DMs, and comments professionally and on-brand

Plan, launch, and actively optimize paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads Manager required; Google Ads a plus) — you will own real budget and be accountable for performance

Track and report on analytics, ad performance (ROAS, CPA, CTR), and audience growth

Organize and maintain a structured content/asset library (raw files, brand assets, past campaign creative) so nothing gets lost between events

Set up automation workflows (scheduling, reporting, repetitive tasks) using AI/automation tools

Flex your schedule around our event calendar — this includes evening/weekend availability tied to specific events, with more predictable hours between events



Requirements:



3-5 years of hands-on social media management experience, including at least 1-2 years managing actual paid ad spend (not just boosting posts)

Comfortable citing real campaign metrics you've moved (ROAS, CPA, CTR) — please reference specific results in your application

Strong copywriting and Canva/graphic design skills

Demonstrated organizational skills — asset/file management, content libraries, structured handoffs

Comfortable using AI/automation tools (ChatGPT, Zapier, etc.) daily

Strong written English communication

Able to flex hours around an events schedule, including some evenings/weekends

Please include: a link to 1-2 examples of paid campaigns you've run (with results if possible), and a one-sentence answer to "what's the first thing you'd check if an ad campaign's performance suddenly dropped?"

title: Part-Time Video Editor — Event & Marketing Content
description:
We host regular events and need a skilled video editor to turn raw footage into polished after-movies, promo teasers, reels, and marketing content for digital ads. This starts as a part-time role (~20 hrs/week) with real potential to grow full-time as event frequency increases. Work arrives in batches after each event — strong turnaround, storytelling instinct, and file organization matter as much as technical editing skill.



Responsibilities:



Edit raw event footage into complete after-movies/recap videos with strong pacing and storytelling

Cut short-form teasers, reels, and promo clips optimized for social and paid ad platforms

Add music, transitions, color grading, and basic motion graphics/text overlays

Deliver multiple format/aspect-ratio versions for different platforms without being asked

Organize and archive raw footage and project files in a clear, findable structure between events

Flex your schedule around our event calendar — expect workload spikes in the days immediately after each event, with lighter weeks in between



Requirements:



2-3+ years of real video editing experience — event recaps, promo/marketing content, or short-form social content specifically (not just personal/hobby projects)

Strong portfolio required — please include links to 2-3 pieces of work most similar to after-movies, event promos, or short-form ad content

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve at a professional level (CapCut alone is not sufficient for this role)

Working knowledge of color grading and basic motion graphics/text animation

Demonstrated file/asset organization — describe how you manage raw footage and project versions across multiple jobs

Able to handle workload that clusters right after events, with fast turnaround on deliverables

Please include: a link to your strongest event or promo edit, and a one-sentence answer to "how do you decide what footage makes the final cut when you have hours of raw material?"

title: Publishing & Book Marketing Manager — Long-Term Fiction Series
description:
I'm looking for someone experienced with indie publishing and book marketing who can take over as much of that side of my business as possible so I can concentrate on writing.



The Perfection Cycle is a planned 10-book speculative-fiction series published under the pen name K.C. Finehope. Books 1–3 are completely finished and ready to publish, and Book 4 is well underway.



Book 1 is already set up on StoryOrigin with current review copies. The author website and MailerLite account are also set up, and I've previously published through Amazon KDP.



I don't need someone to teach me how to self-publish. I could learn the marketing side myself, but I don't want to spend my time doing that when I could be writing the next book. I'm looking for someone who already understands this business and can eventually run most of the publishing and marketing operation with minimal direction from me.



What I need



The immediate priority is getting Book 1 moving: StoryOrigin promotions, ARC/reviewer recruitment and follow-up, newsletter swaps, mailing-list growth, promotional opportunities, social media, and preparation for the KDP launch.



Books 2 and 3 are already finished, so this will quickly become series marketing rather than a one-book project.



Depending on your experience, I'd eventually like you to handle as much as possible of the following:



StoryOrigin and BookFunnel

ARC/review-team recruitment and management

MailerLite and
 marketing

Newsletter swaps and group promotions

KDP management

Metadata, categories and keywords

Launch and release strategy

Kindle Unlimited strategy

Pricing and promotions

Series read-through

Social media management and audience growth

Amazon Ads and Meta Ads

Promotional opportunities and outreach

Tracking results and adjusting the strategy based on what is actually working



You don't need to be an expert in every item on that list. I'd rather have someone be honest about what they know well and where they might eventually recommend bringing in outside expertise.



What matters most is that you understand indie publishing and book marketing, can work independently, and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for me to provide a task list every day.



Why I want to move quickly



The series deals heavily with AI, synthetic companions, human/AI integration, labor displacement, relationships, and the social consequences of technological change.



Some things I originally wrote as speculative fiction are already beginning to happen in the real world. Reality is starting to catch up with the books, and I don't want them sitting on my hard drive while that happens.



That's one reason I already have three books finished before launching the series properly, and why I'm looking for someone who can start moving the marketing side forward while I continue writing.



Long-term opportunity



This isn't a one-book gig.



There are ten books planned, and I'm looking for someone who could potentially stay with the series for years. This will remain a part-time position, with the workload naturally increasing around launches and decreasing between releases.



Ideally, I want to reach the point where you run this side of the business and I write the books.



The posted hourly range is intentionally broad. For the right person, I'm open to discussing a compensation structure that includes meaningful long-term upside in addition to hourly pay. I'm interested in finding someone who wants to help build the series over time and benefit from its success, not simply complete a short-term assignment.



When you apply



Please tell me:



How much of the publishing and marketing operation described above you would be comfortable handling yourself.

With Books 1–3 ready and StoryOrigin already set up, what would you focus on first?

What experience you've had working with indie fiction authors, book launches, or ongoing author marketing.



You don't need to claim you can do everything. I'm much more interested in finding someone experienced, capable, reliable, and interested in building something long term than someone who checks every box.

description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based VAs only)



Read this whole thing before you apply. If you skim it, you'll fail step one.



Smartland manages 1,400+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d
 faster. This role exists to make him faster still: to remove friction, anticipate the next three steps, and never let a ball drop. You are his memory, his logic check, and his second brain.

You think strategically. You see why a task matters, not just what the task is.

When the standard template doesn't fit, you build a better one.

You need detailed instructions to start.

title: Customer Support & Implementation Specialist — GoHighLevel (Full-Time, US Eastern Night Shift)
description:
Before you apply: 6 checkpoints. All 6 are mandatory.



Go through this list honestly. If any one is a "no," please don't apply — you won't pass the screening, and we don't want to waste your time.



☐ 1. English — written. You can write a reply to a US customer that needs zero editing. Correct grammar, natural tone, no Taglish, no AI. Your form answers will be judged exactly as written.



☐ 2. English — spoken and accent. You can talk on Zoom with a US business owner, camera on, and they understand you easily the first time. Neutral or light accent is fine. Heavy accent, reading from a script, or long pauses to find words is not. You must be able to follow fast, casual American speech.



☐ 3. GoHighLevel — hands-on. You have personally worked inside GoHighLevel for at least 1 year. Not watched videos — built things. Sub-accounts, contacts, custom fields, tags, pipelines, the Conversations tab.



☐ 4. Workflows — texting. You have built SMS/text workflows in the GHL workflow builder yourself: trigger → wait → send SMS → if/else → tag → next step. You can explain why each step is there.



☐ 5. Workflows — debugging with Execution Logs. You know where the Execution Logs are on a workflow, you've opened them for a real contact, and you can read them to answer "did the message actually send, and if not, where did it stop?" If you've never opened Execution Logs, this is a no.



☐ 6. US Eastern night shift. You have worked 9 PM – 6 AM Philippine time before, for a US employer, for months — not days. You know you can sustain it. Tell us where and for how long.



If all 6 are "yes," keep reading.



What the job is



Three parts. Roughly half your shift on support, a third on setup, and one protected day a week making videos.



Part 1 — Support (answer customers)



You are the first reply on every support ticket,
, and Slack message. Reply within 1 hour, every time.

Answer "how do I" questions about Tuco inside GoHighLevel.

When a customer says "my contact is in the workflow but nothing shows in Conversations," you open the Execution Logs and the Tuco logs, find out what actually happened, and tell them. No guessing.

If it's a real bug, write a clean ticket for our engineer: steps, contact ID, screenshots, timestamps.



Part 2 — Setup (install Tuco for new customers)



Follow our checklist: install Tuco in the customer's GHL sub-account, connect the line, build their first text workflow, test it with a real contact, confirm the message sent.

Build one clean "reference workflow" the customer can copy to other accounts.

Run short (20–30 minute) onboarding calls on Zoom from a script. You'll shadow the founder first.

Big integration calls (HubSpot, Pipedrive) go to a separate specialist — you just schedule them.



Part 3 — Videos (so we need fewer calls)



Record short screen-recorded tutorials (3–8 minutes) for our YouTube channel and help center. Your voice, your screen.

Rule: any question that comes up on two calls becomes a video.

Publish 1–2 videos a week with a title, description, and a matching help article. Link them in support replies instead of booking a call.

Basic editing only: trim, cut, captions. Loom, Descript, ScreenPal, or CapCut.





Also needed

Customer support experience for a software product or agency clients, in English, with US customers

Comfortable recording your voice explaining software on screen

Fiber internet (25 Mbps+), backup for brownouts, quiet room, webcam, USB or headset mic

Nice to have (not required)

GoHighLevel Certified Admin

Tutorial videos you've already made (link them)

Zapier / Make

Crisp, Intercom, or Zendesk

Worked at an agency managing client sub-accounts





This job is NOT



A general VA job — no calendar, no admin, no social media

Copywriting — customers bring their own text

Sales — no quotas, no cold calls

Why take it

Direct with the founder, online the same hours as you

Stable US company, paid on time every month

You build the support function from scratch — no existing team to fit into

Grows into Head of Customer Success as we grow





How to apply



 me at 
 



1. One Loom video, 3–5 minutes. Camera on, screen shared, no script. This one video tests checkpoints 2, 3, 4 and 5 at once.



Open any SMS/text workflow in any GoHighLevel account (yours, a client's with names hidden, or a trial sub-account you build).

Walk through it step by step: the trigger, each action, each branch, and why it's built that way.

Open that workflow's Execution Logs. Pick one contact's run. Explain what the log shows: where the contact entered, which steps fired, where it waited or stopped, and how you'd use it to answer "did the text actually send?"

Finish by answering this customer out loud, like you're on a call with them: "I've got clients stacking up and your tool is just sitting there because I don't get the workflow builder. I need one hour to get this dialed in. Can you do that?"



2. Written answer (your own words, no AI — tests checkpoint 1). A customer says their contact entered the workflow and should have gotten a text, but nothing shows in the GHL Conversations tab. List, in order, the first 5 things you would check.



3. Night-shift history (checkpoint 6): employer, hours, and dates.



4. Internet speed test screenshot.



5. Expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Optional: link to any GoHighLevel tutorial video you've already made.



7. Type the word "snapshot" in the last box so we know you read this whole post.



What happens next



Within 5 days: we reply to everyone who sent the Loom and the keyword.

About 5 people: a paid 2-hour test inside a sandbox GHL account with Tuco installed — one broken workflow to find and fix, plus a 3-minute Loom explaining the fix to the customer. Paid at your hourly rate.

Final: 30-minute video call with the founder → offer. About 10 days start to finish.



No Loom or no keyword = not reviewed.

title: Intake Calls Specialist
description:
We are seeking a professional and customer-focused Intake Calls Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for prospective and existing clients. This position will be responsible for answering incoming calls, gathering initial client information, identifying the nature of each inquiry, and ensuring callers receive a professional and welcoming experience.

The ideal candidate will have fluent English communication skills, excellent customer service abilities, strong attention to detail, and the confidence to communicate with individuals who may be dealing with sensitive legal matters. Experience in a law firm, legal intake, customer service, or administrative environment is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities:

* Answer and manage incoming calls using the firm's Ooma VoIP phone system.

* Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients and callers.

* Provide a warm, professional, and helpful experience on every call.

* Gather accurate information regarding the caller's needs, contact details, and reason for contacting the firm.

* Conduct initial client intake and document information accurately.

* Identify the appropriate attorney, department, or next step based on the nature of the inquiry.

* Schedule consultations and appointments as directed.

* Follow up with prospective clients when necessary.

* Enter and maintain client and intake information in Clio, the firm's practice management system.

* Maintain accurate and organized intake records.

* Respond to routine client questions professionally while recognizing when an inquiry should be escalated to an attorney or staff member.

* Handle sensitive and confidential client information with discretion.

* Follow established intake procedures, scripts, and escalation protocols.

* Communicate effectively with attorneys and administrative staff regarding new leads and client inquiries.

* Help ensure that no potential client inquiry is missed or left without appropriate follow-up.

* Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service throughout every interaction.



Experience / Background

The ideal candidate should have:

* Previous experience in customer service, call center, client intake, receptionist, legal administration, or a similar role.

* Experience handling a high volume of inbound calls is strongly preferred.

* Previous experience in a law firm or professional services environment is a plus.

* Experience with CRM or practice management software is preferred.

* Familiarity with Clio is a plus, although training will be provided.

* Experience with VoIP phone systems is preferred; familiarity with Ooma is a plus.

* Strong ability to gather information accurately while maintaining a natural and professional conversation.

* Experience handling confidential or sensitive information is highly desirable.



Required Skills:

1. Communication & Customer Service

* Fluent English, both written and verbal.

* Excellent telephone etiquette and professional communication skills.

* Warm, friendly, and empathetic personality.

* Ability to establish trust and rapport quickly with callers.

* Strong active listening skills.

* Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with upset, stressed, or emotional callers.



2. Administrative & Technical Skills

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to multitask while speaking with clients and documenting information.

* Comfortable learning and using new software systems.

* Basic proficiency with
, calendars, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and CRM systems.

* Ability to learn and effectively use Clio after training.

* Comfortable using a VoIP/Ooma phone system.



3. Professional Qualities

* Reliable and dependable.

* Professional and polished telephone presence.

* Highly organized and detail oriented.

* Proactive and able to work independently.

* Discreet when handling confidential client information.

* Willingness to follow established processes and procedures.

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

title: Marketing Associate
description:
THE MARTINEZ TEAM



CMV Commercial



Virtual Assistant



Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)



Reports to: Lisa (Marketing Director)  •  All work routes through Lisa; Gus reviews only when Lisa cannot approve



1. Role Overview

This Virtual Assistant (VA) supports The Martinez Team / CMV Commercial across four core responsibility areas. The role centers on growing the firm’s digital presence, producing content, optimizing the website, and creating listing marketing materials. Throughout, the VA is expected to work fluently in Claude, building reusable Projects and workflows that compound the team’s efficiency over time.

Marketing is mission-critical to this business. This is not a maintenance role. We need a VA who is proactive and forward-thinking — constantly looking for new ways to market the business through social media, SEO, AEO, and AI. Bring ideas to the table, spot opportunities before we ask, and treat growing the firm’s reach as the core of the job.

Start here: Before anything else, study 
 to learn the business — who we are, the asset classes we cover, our markets, our listings, and our voice. Everything the VA produces should reflect a real understanding of the firm.

The Four Core Responsibilities

Social Media Management — grow followers and footprint across all platforms to support lead generation.

Blogs & Newsletters — 2 blogs/month and 1 newsletter/month, CRE-relevant, reviewed and approved by Lisa before publishing.

Website Optimization — SEO and AI/AEO optimization (scope to be finalized with Lisa).

Buildout Listing Marketing — learn Buildout to produce brochures and flyers for listings.

A fifth expectation runs across all four: build and maintain Claude Projects, prompt libraries, and workflows so the team can scale these tasks efficiently.

 Social Media Management

Goal: increase followers and overall footprint across all platforms in a way that generates leads for the brokerage. Posting should reflect the brand voice and highlight CRE expertise, market insight, and active listings.

Standard Weekly Workflow

Review the content calendar and confirm scheduled posts for the week.

Draft platform-native posts (captions, hashtags, image/video specs) using the approved brand voice and an established Claude Project.

Source or create visuals — listing graphics, market stats, team highlights, neighborhood spotlights.

Submit any post that makes a market claim or names a listing for quick review before scheduling.

Schedule posts in the chosen scheduler; stagger across platforms to fit each audience.

Engage daily on active days: respond to comments/DMs, follow relevant local businesses, owners, and CRE accounts.

Log performance weekly (followers, reach, engagement, link clicks, leads).

Growth & Lead-Gen Tactics

Post consistently — aim for a predictable cadence per platform rather than bursts.

Lead with value: market data, “just listed / just closed,” neighborhood insight, and owner-relevant tips.

Use local and CRE hashtags (Broward, Fort Lauderdale, Plantation, Miami-Dade, Palm Beach, #CRE).

Include a clear CTA on lead-oriented posts (DM, link, “contact Gus”).

Repurpose blog and newsletter content into multiple short social posts.

Track which formats drive profile visits and inquiries; double down on what works.



Content Calendar — Plan Well in Advance

The content calendar must be built ahead of time, not week-to-week. Planning in advance is what lets us produce higher-effort content — if the VA suggests a video, a script, or a shoot, we need lead time to prepare it. A good rule of thumb is to have the calendar mapped at least 3–4 weeks out.

Map themes, posts, and key dates 3–4 weeks in advance across all platforms.

Flag any post that needs a script, video, or graphic so there’s time to produce it.

Share the calendar with Lisa so scripts and video work can be scheduled together.

Keep a backlog of evergreen ideas to fill gaps and respond to timely market news.

Be Proactive & Forward-Thinking

We want a VA who is constantly thinking about what should be done next to grow reach — not just executing the list. Watch what’s working, study what competitors and top CRE accounts are doing, and bring recommendations to Lisa.

Proactively pitch new content ideas, formats, and platform strategies to grow followers and reach.

Recommend when video, Reels, or short scripts would outperform static posts — and plan them into the calendar early.

Spot emerging platform trends and test them quickly while they’re still fresh.

Suggest landing pages for individual properties when a listing would benefit from one, and build them as needed.



Definition of Done — Social

All scheduled posts published on time, on-brand, error-free.

Comments and DMs answered within one business day.

Weekly metrics logged in the shared tracker.

3. Responsibility 2 — Blogs & Newsletters

Cadence: 2 blog posts per month and 1 newsletter per month. All content must be relevant to commercial real estate and reviewed and approved by Gus before publishing.

Blog Workflow (2x / Month)

1.    Propose topics from a running content backlog — CRE trends, South Florida market updates, asset-class insights (industrial, office, retail, multifamily, land), and seller/landlord education.



2.    Draft in a Claude Project tuned to the CMV brand voice; target SEO keywords identified for the site. CAN  NOT COPY AND PASTE FROM CLAUDE or ANY OTHER AI Platform.



3.    Self-edit for accuracy, voice, and brand guardrails; run a humanizing pass so copy doesn’t read as AI-generated. and never copy and paste content.



4.    Send to Lisa for review; incorporate edits. (If Lisa cannot approve, she will route it to Gus.)



5.    Publish only after Lisa approves; add internal links, meta description, and a featured image.



6.    Repurpose into social posts and a newsletter segment.



Newsletter Workflow (1x / Month)

5.    Curate the month’s highlights: new listings, closings, market data, and the best blog content.



6.    Draft with a clear subject line, a strong opening, and one primary CTA.



7.    Send to Lisa for review and approval (Lisa escalates to Gus only if needed).



8.    Schedule/send; log open rate, click rate, and any replies/leads.



Approval Rule

Nothing publishes without Lisa’s sign-off. Everything routes through Lisa first; if she is unable to approve, she will have Gus review it. Build review time into the calendar — submit drafts at least 2–3 business days before the intended publish date.



4. Responsibility 3 — Website Optimization (SEO + AI/AEO)

Scope to be finalized with Lisa. The VA must be capable of both traditional SEO and AI/Answer-Engine Optimization (AEO) — structuring content so it surfaces in AI assistants and answer engines, not just search results. This builds on the existing city-page template work (JSON-LD schema, breadcrumb schema, AEO FAQ blocks).



Expected Skill Areas

 On-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, image alt text, page speed basics.

Keyword research: identify terms South Florida CRE sellers/landlords search; map to pages and blog topics.

AEO / structured data: maintain and extend the locked city-page template with JSON-LD, breadcrumb schema, and FAQ blocks.

Content optimization: FAQ sections, original research formats, and clear, citable answers for AI engines.

Measurement: track rankings, organic traffic, and AI-surface visibility over time.

Property landing pages: create dedicated landing pages for individual listings when one is needed, optimized for search and conversion (clear details, CTA, and lead capture).

To Discuss & Finalize With Lisa

Which pages and city pages are the current priority.

Access to the CMS, analytics, and any SEO tooling.

Two open verification items before publishing: whether “KW Commercial” can be named in marketing materials, and whether “Innovation District” is the official corridor name in Pompano Beach.

Reporting cadence and target metrics.



5. Responsibility 4 — Buildout (Brochures & Flyers)

The VA will learn Buildout to create brochures and flyers for any active listings. These materials must follow brand standards and Florida compliance rules.

Ramp-Up Plan

8.    Complete Buildout onboarding/training and get account access.



9.    Learn how listing data flows into brochure and flyer templates.



10.  Produce a first brochure and flyer for review against brand and compliance standards.



11.  Build a repeatable checklist so each new listing gets marketing materials quickly.



Standards for Every Piece

Both the CMV Commercial and The Martinez Team logos at equal size (Florida requirement) — use the combined lockup.

Brand colors and fonts applied 

Accurate listing details; no unverified claims.

Consistent layout and quality across all asset classes.



6. Cross-Cutting — Claude Proficiency & Workflows

Across all four responsibilities, the VA should work fluently in Claude and continuously build assets that make the team faster. The aim is for the VA’s skills to help optimize Claude for future tasks, not just complete one-off work.



Expectations

Build Claude Projects: a dedicated Project per workstream (social, blog/newsletter, SEO/AEO, listing marketing) loaded with brand context, voice, and ICP files.

Maintain a prompt library: save and refine prompts that produce on-brand output reliably.

Document workflows: write down repeatable processes so they can be handed off or scaled.

Quality control: always review Claude output for accuracy, brand voice, and compliance before it ships; humanize AI copy.

Improve over time: note what works, update Projects and prompts, and propose new efficiencies to Lisa.



Foundational Files to Use

brand-context.md, brand-voice.md, and ideal-customer-profile.md — load these into every relevant Claude Project.

Social media posts:

Ongoing / weekly

Lisa (spot-check claims & listings)

Engagement (comments/DMs)

Each active day

Blog posts:

2x per month

Lisa approves

Newsletter:

1x per month

Lisa approves

Website SEO/AEO:

Ongoing (TBD w/ Lisa)

Lisa

Buildout brochures/flyers:

Per new listing

Brand & compliance check

Metrics report:

Weekly + monthly

Lisa

title: E-Commerce Virtual Assistant + Automation Specialist — Long-Term Opportunity
description:
We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can also help us automate repetitive parts of the business.



This is not a traditional VA role where the goal is only to complete assigned tasks.



We are looking for someone who can handle day-to-day e-commerce and administrative work, assist with customer phone calls, and help us identify, build, test, document, and improve automations that make the company more efficient.



## Core Responsibilities



* Assist with customer phone calls

* Create and update product listings

* Work with product titles, descriptions, specifications, and fitment data

* Organize and clean product information

* Work in Excel and Google Sheets

* Perform online research

* Assist with website and e-commerce administrative tasks

* Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve productivity

* Organize images and product files

* Follow detailed written procedures accurately

* Help identify repetitive work that can be automated

* Build, test, and improve automations

* Document completed automations

* Monitor automated processes and troubleshoot problems

* Suggest better or faster ways of completing repetitive work



Experience with BigCommerce, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, APIs, Google Apps Script, Python, or similar tools is a plus.



Automotive knowledge is NOT required. We will provide training.



## Work Schedule — Important



This position requires working during **New York, U.S. business hours — Eastern Time (ET).**



This is required because part of the position includes helping answer customer phone calls and working with our team during normal U.S. business hours.



Applicants must be comfortable working this schedule from the Philippines.



Please do not apply if you are only available during normal Philippine daytime hours.



## Automation Projects



In addition to regular VA responsibilities, you will be assigned specific automation projects.



Each project will have:



* A clearly defined goal

* A target completion date

* Expected results

* Testing requirements

* Documentation requirements

* A defined period for verifying reliability



Examples may include:



* Automating repetitive spreadsheet work

* Automating product-data organization

* Creating workflows between systems

* Using AI to reduce repetitive writing or data-processing work

* Automating reports

* Automating file and image organization

* Reducing manual data entry

* Building repeatable internal workflows

* Automating recurring e-commerce administrative tasks



You are not expected to know how to automate everything on day one.



What matters is your ability to research, learn, troubleshoot, test, and successfully complete projects.



## Automation Bonus Program



Automation projects are eligible for additional performance bonuses separate from regular salary.



An automation will NOT be considered successfully completed simply because it works once.



To qualify for the full automation bonus, the automation must:



* Meet the agreed project requirements

* Work correctly in real-world use

* Be properly tested

* Be documented clearly

* Continue working reliably for at least **30 days**

* Produce the expected result without creating additional unnecessary manual work



### Faster Completion = Higher Bonus



Each automation project will have a target completion date.



Completing a project earlier can result in a **higher bonus**, provided the automation still meets all requirements and successfully completes the 30-day reliability period.



The goal is to reward both:



**Speed + Reliability**



Finishing quickly is valuable, but only if the automation continues working correctly.



An automation completed early but requiring constant repairs will not qualify for the higher bonus.



An automation completed quickly, documented properly, and running successfully for 30 days may qualify for the highest bonus available for that project.



The exact bonus and target dates will be defined before each automation project begins.



## What We Are Looking For



* Strong spoken and written English

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone

* Excellent attention to detail

* Professional and patient customer-service skills

* Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and product data

* Able to follow detailed instructions without guessing

* Strong internet research skills

* Comfortable learning new software

* Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI tools

* Interested in automation and process improvement

* Able to troubleshoot problems independently

* Willing to suggest better ways of doing things

* Reliable internet connection

* Backup internet strongly preferred

* Backup power strongly preferred

* Comfortable working New York / U.S. Eastern Time

* Interested in a long-term position



We value people who do not just ask:



“What task should I do next?”



We are looking for someone who also thinks:



“Why are we doing this manually, and can we make it faster or automate it?”



## Compensation



We are currently evaluating the market and are open to different experience levels.



Please tell us the compensation you believe is appropriate based on your experience and skills.



Do NOT simply write “negotiable.”



Regular salary and automation-performance bonuses are separate.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions:

Please explain:



* What the task was

16. If you were given a repetitive task that you did not know how to automate, what steps would you take to figure it out?



17. What type of work are you best at?

22. How soon could you start?



At the very top of your application, write:



**E-Commerce Automation**



Applications that do not include this phrase or do not answer all questions may not be considered.



Candidates selected for the next stage may be given a short paid skills and automation test.

title: Supply Chain Manager for a Multi-Brand DTC E-commerce Portfolio (Amazon + Shopify)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a group of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands selling physical

products (kits, apparel and accessories, supplements) across Shopify

and Amazon US. Products are manufactured in China and the US and distributed through

warehouses in China, the US and Europe.

Supply chain is currently being handled internally alongside other work,

and it has become the bottleneck. This hire takes it over. Within 60 days

you should own supplier communication, inventory planning and warehouse

planning completely.

This is not a coordinator or data-entry role. You make decisions and you

are judged on results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. INVENTORY FORECASTING AND REPLENISHMENT

   Across every brand and channel (Shopify plus Amazon FBA and AWD).

   No stockouts on winners, no cash locked in dead stock.

2. CHINA FACTORY SOURCING AND NEGOTIATION

   You inherit our existing factory relationships, nurture them, run

   sample rounds, and hunt better suppliers on price, quality and lead

   time.

3. PACKAGING AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

   Write briefs for our in-house designers (boxes, inserts, kits,

   bundles), manage dielines and print specs with factories, approve

   samples.

4. AMAZON PLANNING

   Shipment plans, carton and prep compliance, kit and bundle size rules,

   AWD to FBA replenishment, and resolving Seller Central or warehouse

   restrictions before they cost us money.

5. INTERNATIONAL WAREHOUSE PLANNING

   3PL contracts, capacity and stock allocation across China, the US and

   Europe. Freight forwarding (ocean and air), customs paperwork, landed

   cost tracking.

6. COST REDUCTION

   Unit cost, packaging cost, freight, storage and fulfilment fees. You

   are measured on landed cost per unit and on cash tied up in inventory.

7. PRODUCT LIFECYCLE

   Flag slow movers, plan run-outs, roll them into bundles or mystery

   boxes, keep the catalog clean.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years in ecommerce or DTC supply chain, procurement or logistics.

  Multi-brand or portfolio experience is a strong plus.

- Proven China factory sourcing and negotiation. You have personally

  negotiated unit prices, MOQs and lead times, and won.

- Hands-on Amazon FBA experience: shipment plans, prep and labeling

  requirements, AWD, and dealing with Seller Central restrictions.

- Freight and import knowledge: ocean and air freight, incoterms, customs

  documents, landed cost.

- Strong inventory forecasting. You build and maintain your own models in

  Google Sheets or Excel: sales velocity, lead time, safety stock,

  reorder points.

- Shopify inventory management.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on calls with Chinese

  factories, US warehouses and European suppliers.

- Deadline discipline. We run on Asana. Tasks are not delivered late. If

  something will slip, you flag it BEFORE the due date, not after.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience at an 8 or 9 figure ecommerce brand.

- Packaging design or print production background.

- Setting up a new 3PL or warehouse from scratch.

- Supplement or regulated product experience.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 2800 USD per month, long term, full time.

- Real ownership. You are the decision maker on supply chain, not a

  middleman passing messages.

- Direct access to the decision makers. No layers, no politics.

- Growth. As the group adds brands, this role grows into Head of Supply

  Chain.

HOW TO APPLY

Generic applications are deleted. Answer all six points or do not apply.

1. Put the word ORANGE at the very top of your message so we know you

   read this post.

2. A supplier negotiation you personally ran. Give the product, the

   starting price, the final price, and exactly how you got there.

3. How you d
 reorder quantity and timing for a SKU. Walk us through

   the actual numbers you look at.

4. One time inventory or a shipment went wrong on your watch. What

   happened, and what you changed so it did not happen again.

5. Your Amazon FBA experience in three lines: what you shipped, how

   often, what problems you solved.

6. Your available working hours in GMT+2.

title: Short-Form Content Creator - TikTok / Reels / Shorts | Plix.GG
description:
Plix.gg is a browser gaming platform with 72,000+ games and 300K+ monthly visitors.



We're looking for a creator who genuinely understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, what people are watching, what formats are trending, what sounds are being used and how to turn an idea into a video people actually want to finish.



This is NOT an editing-only role.



You will research trends, find ideas, choose games, record gameplay or real-world footage and edit finished short-form videos.



We handle uploading and posting. You do not need to manage our social accounts.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who actively uses TikTok, Reels and Shorts and pays attention to:



• Current content trends and formats

• Trending music and sounds

• Hooks that stop people scrolling

• Editing styles that are working right now

• Gaming and internet culture

• What other gaming creators are doing

• Why some videos perform and others don't





You should actively research what is currently working and develop concepts independently.

Most importantly, you need good creative judgment.

Not every browser game is interesting enough to carry a video by itself.

Sometimes gameplay is enough.

Sometimes the stronger video is built around a gaming setup, laptop, phone, IRL situation, meme, challenge, POV, trend or relatable idea.



→ Your job is to know the difference.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ CONTENT CAN INCLUDE



• Single-game videos

• Multi-game videos and lists

• Gameplay

• Challenges

• Memes

• POVs

• Gaming setup / desk setup videos

• Laptop, monitor and phone footage

• Gaming room / RGB setup footage

• IRL videos filmed at home, schools, cafés, malls, outdoors, etc.

• Voiceover or no voiceover

• Trend-based concepts

• Videos built around a joke, situation or trend instead of only gameplay



If you have a good-looking gaming setup, desk, room, laptop or another visually interesting environment, we want you to use it.



For example:



→ Open with a good-looking gaming setup

→ Hook: "3 browser games I play when I'm bored"

→ Transition into the games



We want variety.



We do NOT want the same template repeated every day. But we can try good templates that did not work more times.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT YOU DO



• Research TikTok, Reels and Shorts for trends, formats, sounds and ideas

• Follow gaming creators and relevant competitors

• Find games on Plix.gg worth making content about

• Develop your own concepts and hooks

• D
 whether a video should be gameplay, IRL, setup-based, meme, POV, challenge, list, trend or another format

• Record clean gameplay

• Film attractive real-world or gaming-setup footage when needed

• Edit 10–40 second short-form videos

• Choose suitable music, trending sounds and SFX

• Add captions and on-screen text

• Test different opening hooks

• Use performance feedback from previous videos to improve future concepts



You do not need to show your face or use your own voice.



You can if you want to, but it is not required.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ OUTPUT



5–7 finished videos per week.

Videos can vary significantly in format and production effort.

Some can be simple gameplay videos.

Others may use several games, IRL footage, gaming setups, multiple locations or more complicated concepts.

We care about retention, creativity and views, not forcing every video into the same structure.

We handle publishing.



Your responsibility is delivering finished videos ready to post.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ YOU SHOULD HAVE



• Strong understanding of TikTok, Reels and Shorts

• Strong short-form editing skills

• Good instinct for hooks and first 1–3 second retention

• Awareness of current trends, sounds, formats and editing styles

• Genuine interest in games and internet culture

• Ability to develop ideas independently

• Ability to research what is currently performing

• Ability to film good-looking real-world or gaming-setup footage

• Good sense of pacing, music, captions, SFX and visual composition



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ EQUIPMENT



You need:



• PC or laptop capable of smoothly recording browser games

• Smartphone with a good camera

• Reliable internet

• CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or similar



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ HOURS

title: Wholesale & Ecommerce Operations Coordinator

JOB DETAILS:



Job Title: Wholesale & Ecommerce Operations Coordinator

Location: Remote

Reports To: Operations / Leadership

Work Shift: Flexible with overlap during US business hours preferred

Working Hours: Part-Time (Approximately 20 hours/week; workload may vary seasonally)



Job Description



We are seeking a highly organized Wholesale & Ecommerce Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day execution of wholesale, ecommerce, and fulfillment operations for a growing consumer brand.



The primary focus of this role is managing wholesale orders from approval through fulfillment, including coordinating with warehouse partners, communicating with specialty retail accounts, managing invoicing and payment follow-up, and ensuring orders are processed accurately and on time.



The role will also support ecommerce and broader operational workflows, including Shopify product setup, larger retail shipments, inbound inventory coordination, and warehouse management system updates. While some of these responsibilities may be introduced over time, we're looking for someone capable of growing into broader operational ownership as they become familiar with the business.



The ideal candidate is exceptionally detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces simultaneously. There are many order details, deadlines, retailer requirements, inventory movements, and internal trackers involved, so accuracy and follow-through are critical.



This is not a wholesale sales or inventory planning role. Success in this position depends on strong operational execution, attention to detail, communication, and the ability to keep orders and inventory-related workflows organized from start to finish.



Key Responsibilities:



Wholesale Order Management

Review and approve specialty wholesale orders based on established business guidelines

Verify order requirements, minimum order quantities, inventory availability, and other relevant details

Manage wholesale orders from approval through fulfillment

Maintain accurate order records, documentation, and status trackers

Monitor outstanding orders and proactively follow up on next steps

Ensure orders are processed accurately and according to required timelines

Help resolve order discrepancies and other operational issues as they arise



Specialty Retail Account Support

Serve as a point of contact for specialty and boutique wholesale customers throughout the order process

Communicate order updates, shipping timelines, inventory issues, and fulfillment changes

Respond to order-related questions and help resolve customer issues

Maintain professional and responsive communication across approximately 50–100 specialty store orders during a given season

Ensure outstanding retailer requests and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time



Big-Box Retail Operations Support

Support the operational execution of orders for larger retail partners

Coordinate retailer-specific shipping requirements, labels, documentation, and other fulfillment requirements

Prepare and organize information needed for upcoming retail shipments

Coordinate with internal stakeholders and warehouse partners to ensure shipments are prepared correctly

Track upcoming shipment requirements and proactively communicate necessary next steps

Support the management of larger retail orders without owning direct retailer communication unless required



Warehouse & Fulfillment Coordination

Coordinate with warehouse partners on order packing, shipping, and fulfillment

Provide the warehouse with required order information, shipping labels, and documentation

Monitor order and shipment progress to ensure deadlines are met

Communicate inventory discrepancies or fulfillment issues to relevant stakeholders

Help resolve packing, shipping, and fulfillment challenges

Maintain clear communication between wholesale operations and warehouse partners



Inbound Inventory Coordination

Support inbound inventory shipments from factories and suppliers

Notify warehouse partners of upcoming inbound shipments

Complete required inbound shipment forms and documentation

Enter and maintain inbound shipment information within warehouse management systems

Track inbound shipments and ensure required information is communicated accurately

Help resolve discrepancies involving incoming inventory or warehouse receiving
